method: Proof-of-Learning (PoL): log checkpoints, batch indices, data signatures and metadata during training, then verify by re-executing the top-Q largest k-step updates per epoch within a slack bound delta

pipeline.step: 初始化来源判定与冷启动采样
pipeline.input: 训练元数据 M 与初始化元数据 M0；可选的外部初始权重 W0 及其证明 P0
pipeline.output: W0 以及来源记录（冷启动策略 zeta 或热启动的 P0）

params.init_strategy: Xavier/Kaiming/Orthogonal 等公开已知策略之一（§V-D4）

pipeline.step: 每轮批次索引划分
pipeline.input: 数据集 D（n 个样本）与每轮步数 S
pipeline.output: 每个 epoch 的 S 个批次索引集合

pipeline.step: 训练步（被记录对象）
pipeline.input: W_t（展平维度 d）、D[I_t]（batch 大小 m）、M_t

params.eta: 学习率，论文未给出统一取值
params.optimizer: 任一梯度下降变体，须在已知可接受算法列表内（§IV-C）

pipeline.step: 逐步记录数据索引与数据签名
pipeline.input: I_t（batch 索引集合，大小 128）、D[I_t]、M_t
pipeline.output: 有序集合 I、H=h(D[I_t])、M，长度各为 T=E*S

pipeline.step: 按间隔 k 记录权重检查点
pipeline.input: 每步权重 W_t
pipeline.output: 长度 T 的稀疏权重列表 W，只有 t mod k = 0 的位置非空（其余为 nil），实际检查点数为 E*S/k

params.k: 检查点间隔；实验取值 k=1、k=12、k=S=390、k=E*S=78000（表 I、图 3、§VI-C4）

pipeline.step: 打包、加密、签名与发布
pipeline.output: 密文证明 R = enc((W,I,H,A), K_V_pub) 及签名 h(R, K_T_priv)

params.enc: 论文未说明具体加密方案
params.timestamp: 可选，时间戳或公开账本（§V-A）

pipeline.step: 验证者验签与解密
pipeline.input: R、T 的公钥、K_V_priv
pipeline.output: 明文 (W, I, H, M)

pipeline.step: 初始状态溯源验证
pipeline.input: W0 与声称的初始化策略 zeta，或历史证明 R0
pipeline.output: PASS 或 FAIL（FAIL 则整份 PoL 无效）

params.test: 逐层单次 Kolmogorov-Smirnov 检验（§V-D4）
params.multiple_testing: 层间不独立时用 Bonferroni 校正（§V-D4）

pipeline.step: 计算并排序各 k 步更新幅度
pipeline.input: 解密得到的稀疏 W 列表
pipeline.output: 每个 epoch 内按 k 步更新幅度降序的索引列表 idx

params.d1: 距离度量，如 p-范数；实验用 l1/l2/linf/cosine（§V-C、表 I）
params.frequency: 每次 t mod k = 0 且 t != 0 计算一次，进入新 epoch 时排序并清空 mag

pipeline.step: top-Q 选择
pipeline.input: idx 与验证预算 Q
pipeline.output: 至多 Q*E 个待验证的 k 步窗口起点 (e, q)

params.Q: 每轮验证的最大更新个数，总预算 Q*E；拼接攻击实验中 Q=1 足够（§V-C、§VII-C1）

pipeline.step: 数据签名校验与懒披露
pipeline.input: H_t 与 D[I_t]
pipeline.output: 数据一致性 PASS/FAIL；私有数据时由 T 披露 D[I_t]

pipeline.step: 重执行 k 步并做距离判定
pipeline.input: W_t、该窗口的 D[I_{t..t+k-1}] 与 M_{t..t+k-1}
pipeline.output: 该窗口 PASS/FAIL

params.d2: 距离度量，可与 d1 不同（§V-C）
params.delta: 松弛阈值，要求 max_t eps_repr(t) < delta < d_ref；论文未给具体数值（§V-C）

pipeline.step: 汇总判定
pipeline.input: 所有 epoch、所有 q 的比对结果
pipeline.output: Success 或 FAIL

params.rule: 任一 epoch 的 VERIFYEPOCH 返回 FAIL 即 FAIL，否则遍历完 t in [0,T-1] 后 Success

pipeline.step: 链式信任记录查询
pipeline.input: 历史已验证证明记录 P0..PR
pipeline.output: 热启动初始状态的 PASS/FAIL

params.vsr: 整体成功率按式 (5) 连乘下降（§VIII）

method: CRFL: server-side parameter clipping and Gaussian perturbing during federated training, plus test-time randomized parameter smoothing with Hoeffding-calibrated certified radius (Algorithm 1 + Algorithm 2, Corollary 1 Eq. 2)

pipeline.step: 服务器下发（噪声）全局模型
pipeline.input: 服务器持有的全局参数 ẽw_{t-1} ∈ R^d（t=1 时为初始模型 w_0）
pipeline.output: 每个客户端本轮的初始化模型 ẽw_{t-1}
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 'The server sends ẽw_{t-1} to the i-th client'；Section 4.1；Algorithm 1 Server's input ẽw_0 ← w_0

pipeline.step: 客户端本地 mini-batch SGD
pipeline.input: 初始化 w^i_{(t-1)τ_i} = ẽw_{t-1}，本地数据集 S_i（大小 n_i），mini-batch ξ^i_s ⊂ S_i（批大小 n_Bi）
pipeline.output: 本地模型 w^i_{tτ_i}

pipeline.step: 客户端计算并上传更新增量
pipeline.input: 本地模型 w^i_{tτ_i} 与本轮初始化 ẽw_{t-1}
pipeline.output: Δ^i_t = w^i_{tτ_i} − ẽw_{t-1} ∈ R^d
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 'The i-th client sends w^i_{tτ_i} − ẽw_{t-1} to the server'；Section 3.1

pipeline.step: 服务器加权聚合
pipeline.input: N 个更新增量 Δ^i_t ∈ R^d，聚合权重 p_i（p_i ≥ 0，Σp_i = 1）
pipeline.output: w_t = ẽw_{t-1} + Σ_{i=1}^N p_i·Δ^i_t ∈ R^d
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 'The server updates the model parameters'；Section 3.1

pipeline.step: 服务器裁剪聚合模型的 ℓ2 范数
pipeline.input: w_t ∈ R^d 与阈值 ρ_t
pipeline.output: Clip_{ρ_t}(w_t) = w_t / max(1, ‖w_t‖_2/ρ_t)
pipeline.source: Section 4.1；Algorithm 1 'The server clips the model parameters'；Table 1

pipeline.step: 服务器加各向同性高斯噪声（t ≤ T−1）
pipeline.input: Clip_{ρ_t}(w_t) 与噪声标准差 σ_t
pipeline.output: ẽw_t = Clip_{ρ_t}(w_t) + ε_t，ε_t ~ N(0, σ_t²·I)，逐坐标独立
pipeline.source: Section 4.1；Algorithm 1 的 if t ≤ T−1 分支；Appendix A.1

pipeline.step: 最后一轮只裁剪并输出最终全局模型
pipeline.input: w_T ∈ R^d 与阈值 ρ_T
pipeline.output: M(D) := Clip_{ρ_T}(w_T)

params.rho_T: 按 Table 1 调度在 t=T 处取值

pipeline.source: Section 4.1 'In the final round T, we only clip the global model parameters'；Algorithm 1 Output

pipeline.step: 测试期参数平滑：生成 M 个噪声模型
pipeline.input: Clip_{ρ_T}(w_T)，平滑测度 µ(w) = N(w, σ_T²I)
pipeline.output: M 个（伪代码循环为 M+1 个）噪声模型 ẽw^k_T = Clip_{ρ_T}(w_T) + ε^k_T，ε^k_T ~ N(0, σ_T²·I)

pipeline.step: 对单个测试样本做投票计数
pipeline.input: 测试样本 x_test，M 个噪声模型参数，基础分类器 h(·,·)
pipeline.output: 类别计数向量 counts ∈ N^C；ĉ_A、ĉ_B = 票数最高与次高类；ˆp_A = counts[ĉ_A]/M，ˆp_B = counts[ĉ_B]/M

pipeline.step: Hoeffding 置信下界与上界
pipeline.input: ˆp_A、ˆp_B、误差容忍 α、Monte Carlo 样本数
pipeline.output: p_A = ˆp_A − √(log(1/α)/(2N))，p_B = ˆp_B + √(log(1/α)/(2N))（原文分母写作 2N，疑应为 2M）
pipeline.source: Section 4.2 CalculateBound 段；Algorithm 2 'Calculate lower and upper bounds of pA, pB'；Section 6.1

pipeline.step: 接受或弃权判定
pipeline.input: p_A、p_B
pipeline.output: 若 p_A > p_B 则输出预测 ĉ_A 并继续；否则输出 ABSTAIN 与 RAD = 0
pipeline.source: Algorithm 2 'if pA > pB' 分支；Theorem 1 与 Theorem 3 的前提条件

method: MUD-HoG (Malicious and Unreliable client Detection using History of Gradients)

pipeline.step: 预热轮直接聚合全部客户端梯度
pipeline.input: 第 1 到 τ0 轮所有 N 个客户端的本地更新 ∇_{t,i}，每个客户端一个 d 维向量
pipeline.output: 预热轮聚合梯度，用于 w_{τ+1} = w_τ − η∇_τ
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 Lines 2-3；τ0 = 3 见 Section 4.2 与 Section 5.1

pipeline.step: 计算短 HoG（移动平均）
pipeline.input: 客户端 c_i 最近 l 轮梯度 ∇_{τ−l,i}…∇_{τ−1,i}，形状 l×d
pipeline.output: 短 HoG ∇sHoG_i，d 维；汇总为 N×d

pipeline.step: 计算长 HoG（历史累加）
pipeline.input: 客户端 c_i 第 1 到 τ−1 轮全部梯度
pipeline.output: 长 HoG ∇lHoG_i，d 维

pipeline.step: 全体客户端短 HoG 逐元素中位数
pipeline.input: N×d 短 HoG 矩阵
pipeline.output: 中位数短 HoG ∇sHoG_med，d 维

pipeline.step: 计算各客户端短 HoG 到中位数的余弦度量
pipeline.input: ∇sHoG_med（d 维）与每个 ∇sHoG_i（d 维）
pipeline.output: N 个标量 dcos

pipeline.step: 符号翻转攻击者判定
pipeline.input: 每个客户端的 dcos 标量
pipeline.output: Cuntar（符号翻转）

pipeline.step: 对剩余客户端短 HoG 做密度聚类分组
pipeline.input: (N − |Cuntar|)×d 短 HoG 矩阵
pipeline.output: 小组 gl（加噪攻击者 + 不可靠客户端）与小组 gh（其余客户端）

pipeline.step: 用大组 gh 重算中位数短 HoG
pipeline.input: gh 中客户端的短 HoG 矩阵
pipeline.output: 新的 ∇sHoG_med，d 维

pipeline.step: 计算小组 gl 各客户端到中位数的欧氏距离集合 d
pipeline.input: ∇sHoG_med 与 gl 中每个 ∇sHoG_i
pipeline.output: 标量集合 d

pipeline.step: 在排序距离上取最大间隔中点作为分离边界 dφ
pipeline.input: 排序后的距离集合 d（或步骤 15 的余弦集合 d′）
pipeline.output: 标量阈值 dφ
pipeline.source: Section 4.2 第 2 段；Algorithm 1 Line 13；Section 4.3；Algorithm 1 Line 21

pipeline.step: 加噪攻击者判定
pipeline.input: gl 中各客户端的 dEuc 与本轮的 dφ
pipeline.output: Cuntar（加噪）

pipeline.step: 对剩余客户端长 HoG 做 K-means 二聚类，小簇为有目标攻击者
pipeline.input: (N − |Cuntar|)×d 长 HoG 矩阵
pipeline.output: Ctar（较小簇）与剩余客户端集合

pipeline.step: 对剩余客户端重算中位数短 HoG
pipeline.input: Call \ {Ctar ∪ Cuntar} 的短 HoG 矩阵
pipeline.output: 新的 ∇sHoG_med，d 维

pipeline.step: 再次计算余弦度量得到集合 d′
pipeline.input: ∇sHoG_med 与每个剩余客户端的 ∇sHoG_i
pipeline.output: 标量集合 d′

pipeline.step: 不可靠客户端判定
pipeline.input: 剩余客户端的 dcos 与本轮的 dφ
pipeline.output: Cunrl

pipeline.step: 求正常客户端集合
pipeline.input: Call、Ctar、Cuntar、Cunrl
pipeline.output: Cnorm

pipeline.step: 连续两轮确认才做确定判决
pipeline.input: 相邻两轮对同一客户端的检测标记
pipeline.output: 确认后的恶意客户端集合

pipeline.step: 剔除恶意、按 α 降权不可靠后的加权聚合
pipeline.input: Cnorm 与 Cunrl 中各客户端的 ∇_{τ,i}，以及样本量 |Di|、|D|
pipeline.output: 本轮聚合梯度 ∇_τ

pipeline.step: 全局模型更新并下发
pipeline.input: w_τ 与 ∇_τ
pipeline.output: w_{τ+1}，下发给全部客户端

quotes.supports: 步骤 2：短 HoG 为最近 l 轮梯度的移动平均
quotes.text: is a moving average of ci’s gradients of the last l rounds, where l is the sliding window size. The short HoG smooths a client’s gradients to remove single-round randomness.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：长 HoG 为全部历史梯度的累加
quotes.text: which is the sum of all the gradients in the set ∇i. Thus, the long HoG captures the accumulated influence of a client on the global model, which reflects its goal.

quotes.text: First, in the case of sign-flipping attack, a malicious client essentially changes its gradient to the opposite direction, which would result in a large angular deviation from the median gradient of all the clients

quotes.supports: 步骤 10 与步骤 15：最大间隔中点作为分离边界 dφ
quotes.text: Then, we find the largest gap between any two consecutive values in the sorted list of the set d, and use the mid-point of this gap as the separation boundary dφ.

quotes.supports: 步骤 12：K = 2 的 K-means 取较小簇为有目标攻击者
quotes.text: Then, we apply K-means clustering with K = 2 on all the computed long HoGs to obtain two groups of clients: the smaller group will consist of the targeted attackers

quotes.text: Note that the cosine distance is smaller when the angle between two vectors is larger, and that is why the condition ‘<’ used in (8) is opposite to that in (7).

quotes.supports: 步骤 18：连续两轮确认与最早检测轮次
quotes.text: we make a firm decision about malicious clients if they are detected in two consecutive rounds. Therefore, our algorithm can only detect malicious clients at least after 4 rounds.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：基线 BP 浓度取 c = 5
quotes.text: In our experiments (as discussed later in Sect. 6), we initially choose a random baseline of c = 5 and continuously update it based on the posteriors of client updates.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：基测度 H 的 µp、σp 来自展平后的初始全局模型
quotes.text: Further, we choose a base measure H = N(µp,σp) with µp equal to the mean of the ﬂattened initial global model and σp equal to the standard deviation of the ﬂattened initial global deviation

quotes.supports: 步骤 2：第一轮共用 H，逐客户端浓度由 Poisson process 生成
quotes.text: before the training starts, we assign the same base measure of H to each client selected in the ﬁrst training round, and concentration parameters (for each client) are computed as random variables of a Poisson process with parameter c.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：更新展平为 l 维向量并视为 BeP 抽样
quotes.text: we ﬂatten updates for each client i to a one-dimensional vector having l values, denoted as Wi. We assume that each value in this vector is drawn from a Bernoulli Process (BeP)

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：用余弦角距离更新客户端权重（Eq. (2) 的动机）
quotes.text: First, we update each client’s local model using the cosine angular distance (cos(Wt i ,Gt−1)) between the local model and the global model.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：测量误差中的 d 为 G^{t−1} 与 W_i^t 的 L2 范数
quotes.text: where dwt i is the L2 −norm between the global model in the previous round Gt−1 and client i update in the current round Wt i.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：把本轮基测度 H^t 融入 p 分布
quotes.text: Here, we integrate the current round base measure Ht to compute p distribution of client updates, such that the detection phase of the defense is not affected by any local client training strategy.

quotes.supports: 步骤 13：两类 Max_JD 模式驱动的过滤规则
quotes.text: (i) the Maxi JD computed for malicious updates are much greater than that for the benign updates, and (ii) the computed Maxi JD values for the malicious updates are similar to each other.

quotes.supports: 步骤 O1/R1：分配矩阵 A 的离线设计与向客户端共享
quotes.text: Matrix A—and hence the corresponding bipartite graph—is a design choice that may be decided offline, analogous to the model architecture, and shared with the clients for transparency.

quotes.supports: 步骤 R3：按测试组做安全聚合，服务器只看到组聚合模型
quotes.text: In FedGT, for each test group, a secure aggregation mechanism is employed to reveal only the aggregate of the client models in the test group to the server.

quotes.supports: 步骤 R4–R7：把组聚合模型按恶意客户端数量聚类，形成测试
quotes.text: Motivated by this observation, we propose a testing strategy in which we first cluster the test groups (i.e., the corresponding aggregated models) into clusters based on the number of malicious clients involved in the test group.

quotes.supports: 步骤 R8–R10：先用 Silhouette 判断单簇/多簇，再用 Dunn 定簇数
quotes.text: To address these limitations, we propose a combined approach: first, we use the Silhouette score to assess whether the data should be clustered into one or several clusters.

quotes.supports: 步骤 R11：最高平均效用簇判为阴性、其余判为阳性
quotes.text: we declare the result of the test for the test groups within the cluster with highest average utility as negative (t = 0) and the result of the test for all other test groups as positive (t = 1).

quotes.supports: 步骤 O2/R13：用阴性测试数做最大似然估计 n̂_m 及其局限
quotes.text: The likelihood Pr(Z = ˆz|Nm = nm) can be computed exactly for small enough assignment matrices A. Note that the accuracy of the estimate is expected to deteriorate with increasing test noise.

quotes.supports: 步骤 R14/R17：判决阈值 Λ 依赖未知的恶意客户端流行度，需要估计
quotes.text: Note that Λ depends on the prevalence, i.e., the number of malicious clients nm, which is in general not known. In the following, we provide the means to estimate nm.

quotes.supports: 步骤 R15–R16：用 A 的 trellis 表示做前向-后向以得到后验 LLR
quotes.text: The a posteriori LLRs can be computed efficiently using the trellis representation of matrix A introduced in the previous subsection via the forward-backward algorithm [36].

quotes.text: we construct Dtrain clean_reset, a dataset where the labels of the training samples are reset. This reset operation is to ensure that clean samples yield low confidence scores so that they are distinguishable from high confidence of poisoned samples

quotes.supports: 步骤 2：用 PEFT 在重置标签数据上持续训练 PSIM（公式 (1)）
quotes.text: Secondly, we leverage PEFT methods to continually train the poisoned model on Dtrain clean_reset. Formally, the training of PSIM is as follows

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 的设计理由：拉开置信度差距且不破坏触发器—目标关联
quotes.text: This approach has the advantage of effectively widening the confidence score gap between poisoned samples and clean samples, without disrupting the intrinsic connection between the pre-defined triggers and targets.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：PSIM 置信度在干净/中毒样本上的输出形态

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：阈值判定规则

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：过滤动作与干净准确率

method: Obliviate

pipeline.step: 冻结可能被投毒的 PLM 并插入随机初始化的 PEFT 层
pipeline.input: 可能含 task-agnostic backdoor 的 PLM 权重（roberta-base/bert-base-uncased，及 large 版）+ 干净下游训练集
pipeline.output: 仅 PEFT 层可训练、PLM 参数冻结的模型
pipeline.source: Section 3 (Defense setting), Section 5.1.4, Appendix C, Table 7

pipeline.step: 神经元放大损失：对 PEFT 层权重范数求和取负
pipeline.input: 每个 transformer 层 i 中的 PEFT 层权重集合 {W_p}：adapter 的 up/down-projection 矩阵、LoRA 的分解矩阵、prefix-tuning 的 reparametrization 矩阵
pipeline.output: 标量 Lamp

params.formula: Lamp = - sum_{i in L} sum_{p in P_i} ||W_p||_2
params.scope: all transformer layers, all PEFT layers

pipeline.step: 注意力分数正则损失：对每个注意力头的注意力分数求 L2 范数并求和
pipeline.input: 每层 i、每个头 h 的注意力分数 a_h；句分类任务下取输入 token 对 [CLS] 输出的注意力
pipeline.output: 标量 Lreg

params.formula: Lreg = sum_{i in L} sum_{h in H_i} ||a_h||_2

pipeline.step: 与下游任务损失加权组合成总损失
pipeline.input: Ltask、Lamp、Lreg 与系数 λamp、λreg
pipeline.output: 标量总损失 L

params.formula: L = Ltask + lambda_amp * Lamp + lambda_reg * Lreg

pipeline.step: 标准 PEFT 反向传播与参数更新
pipeline.input: 总损失 L 与当前 PEFT 层参数
pipeline.output: 更新后的 PEFT 层参数（PLM 保持冻结）

pipeline.step: 在干净验证集上按 CACC 下降不超过 2% 选择损失系数
pipeline.input: λamp / λreg 候选集合 + 干净验证集上的 CACC
pipeline.output: 两个标量系数 λamp、λreg

params.criterion: largest values with no more than 2% CACC drop on validation set

pipeline.source: Section 5.1.4, Appendix C (Defense setup), Table 7, Appendix F / Figure 9

pipeline.step: 推理时不做任何输入过滤或额外预测

quotes.supports: 步骤 0/1：检测器离线训练于 OOD 数据
quotes.text: Our key insight is that backdoored prompt vectors yield representations that deviate from the distribution of clean data in CLIP’s embedding space. SABRE-FL trains a detector offline, on an out-of-distribution dataset, to recognize these deviations.

quotes.supports: 步骤 0：构造辅助干净/污染嵌入集 D_aux
quotes.text: We simulate this behavior by generating a training dataset Daux = {(zi, yi)}N i=1 of clean and poisoned embeddings on an auxiliary dataset (Caltech-101). Here, yi ∈ {0, 1} indicates whether zi is clean or poisoned.

quotes.supports: 步骤 0：冻结编码器 + 固定 prompt learner 生成嵌入并打标
quotes.text: Both clean and triggered images are passed through the frozen image encoder fimg(·) and a fixed prompt learner to obtain their embeddings. These embeddings are then labeled as clean (yi = 0) or poisoned (yi = 1).

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：检测器结构与二分类交叉熵损失
quotes.text: We train a detector D : Rd →{0, 1} to minimize binary cross-entropy loss over this embedding dataset. The model architecture is a two-layer multilayer perceptron (MLP) with a hidden layer of size 128 and ReLU activation.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：客户端只上传 CLIP 嵌入
quotes.text: Clients share only CLIP-encoded image representations with the server which are compressed, task-agnostic vectors produced by a frozen backbone.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：式(7) 的客户端平均检测分
quotes.text: At inference time, when a client Ck submits a set of embeddings {zk j }nk j=1, we compute the mean detector score

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：rank-based top-m 剔除代替固定阈值
quotes.text: Rather than using a fixed threshold τ, we adopt a rank-based heuristic: in each round, the m clients with the highest number of flagged embeddings are excluded from aggregation.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：需要 m 已知或有上界（附录口径）
quotes.text: Specifically, in each communication round, we assume m out of n clients may be malicious, and we remove the m clients with the highest number of flagged embeddings (or highest Sk scores).

method: Verifiable Fine-Tuning (VFT): zero-knowledge per-step training proofs bound to a dataset commitment and a policy manifest, recursively aggregated and partially verified per client in federated settings

pipeline.step: commit_dataset
pipeline.input: per-example tuples (x_i, y_i, meta_i) over the training universe D, meta_i = (source_id, license_id, proc_digest, policy_tags)
pipeline.output: Merkle root c_D and per-leaf digests l_i
pipeline.source: Sec. III.B (S1), Sec. III.D.a, Sec. IV.A.e, Sec. III.M.d

pipeline.step: commit_attribute_counters
pipeline.input: auxiliary counter vector u (label histograms, length buckets, bin counts)
pipeline.output: vector commitment c_u

pipeline.step: bind_manifest
pipeline.input: policy manifest: data sources/licenses, preprocessing code digests, eligibility filters, sampler descriptor, PEFT structure and ranks, optimizer hyperparameters and schedules, approximation budgets
pipeline.output: manifest hash h_Pi as public input; optional notary record (c_D, h_0, h_Pi)
pipeline.source: Sec. III.I, Sec. III.B (S1), Sec. III.Q.a

pipeline.step: verifiable_sample_batch
pipeline.input: public seed s, step t, batch size, |D| (public mode); per-run nonce and local subtree (private mode)
pipeline.output: index set I_t; in public mode fully replayable from (s, t); in private mode an index-hiding witness

params.seed_policy: randomness fully determined by (s, t) in public mode

pipeline.source: Sec. III.B (S2), Sec. III.D.b, Sec. IV.B.e, Sec. IV.B.f, Sec. IV.E.b

pipeline.step: prove_membership
pipeline.input: index i, leaf l_i, root c_D
pipeline.output: Merkle path(i) in public mode; zero-knowledge membership proof in private mode

pipeline.step: check_quota_constraints
pipeline.input: per-step selection indicator e_t in {0,1}^|D|, binning matrix M in {0,1}^{B x |D|}, per-epoch per-bin quotas gamma in N^B
pipeline.output: boolean quota satisfaction plus a quota certificate (range proofs on gamma)

params.equation: Eq. (3): sum_{t in epoch} M e_t <= gamma elementwise

pipeline.source: Eq. (3), Sec. III.D.c, Sec. III.H, Algorithm 1 lines 4 and 9

pipeline.step: fixed_point_project
pipeline.input: real-valued tensors x (activations, gradients, optimizer states)
pipeline.output: integer encodings x_bar in F_p plus an error budget epsilon_fxp
pipeline.source: Eq. (5), Sec. III.F.a, Sec. IV.B.e, Sec. III.M.c

pipeline.step: approximate_softmax
pipeline.input: per-token pre-softmax logits z in R^L
pipeline.output: approximated attention weights plus a bounded error certificate

params.form: rational/polynomial over a clipped range with lookup tables

pipeline.source: Eq. (4), Sec. III.E.b, Table III, Sec. V.H.a

pipeline.step: approximate_nonlinearities
pipeline.input: GELU inputs; AdamW denominator term v_hat + epsilon
pipeline.output: approximated GELU values; approximated r = 1/sqrt(v_hat + epsilon)

params.table: T of (v_hat, r) pairs with slope-checked linear segments

pipeline.step: lora_forward_with_frozen_hash
pipeline.input: frozen weight W in R^{d_out x d_in}, adapters A in R^{r x d_in}, B in R^{d_out x r}, activations x
pipeline.output: layer output y and adapter delta W = BA; frozen tensors tied to public commitments by hash equality

params.placement: attention and MLP projections (optionally attention only)

pipeline.source: Sec. III.E.a, Sec. IV.B.e, Sec. IV.D.b

pipeline.step: peft_restricted_backward
pipeline.input: forward activations, labels, surrogate cross-entropy loss
pipeline.output: gradient g_t restricted to adapter tensors

params.loss: causal-LM cross entropy, per-token l = -log p_y with p = f_sm(z)
params.integrity: layer-wise activation checksums tied to hashes

pipeline.step: clip_gradients_fixed_point
pipeline.input: gradient g_t on adapter tensors
pipeline.output: clipped gradient

pipeline.step: adamw_update
pipeline.input: gradient g_t, moments (m_t, v_t), learning rate eta_t
pipeline.output: updated adapters theta_{t+1} and moments (m_{t+1}, v_{t+1})

pipeline.step: commit_optimizer_state
pipeline.input: moment tensors (m_t, v_t)
pipeline.output: state commitments linked into a hash chain

pipeline.step: hash_chain_state
pipeline.input: previous digest h_t, structured update delta_t, learning rate eta_t, metadata meta_t
pipeline.output: h_{t+1} bound inside the step proof together with local adapter commitments

params.equation: Eq. (6): h_{t+1} = H(h_t || H(delta_t) || eta_t || meta_t)

pipeline.step: generate_step_proof
pipeline.input: witness (batch, activations, gradients, optimizer states) and public inputs (h_Pi, c_D, h_t)
pipeline.output: step proof pi_t binding (h_t, h_{t+1})

params.acceptance: per-coordinate interval membership with tolerance tau = delta_sm + epsilon_fxp
params.pseudocode: PROVEUPDATE announced in Sec. III.K but absent from the extracted text

pipeline.source: Sec. III.B (S3), Sec. III.F.a, Sec. III.K

pipeline.step: recursive_fold
pipeline.input: set of verified leaf proofs {pi_t} or epoch proofs {Pi_e}
pipeline.output: epoch proofs {Pi_e}, then a single final proof pi, plus digest h_T

params.recursion: cycle of curves or native recursion

pipeline.source: Sec. III.H, Sec. III.M.b, Algorithm 1 lines 6 and 11

pipeline.step: verify_proof
pipeline.input: (h_0, c_D, h_Pi) and either {pi_t} or {Pi_e}
pipeline.output: (pi, h_T) or acceptance/rejection
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 lines 1-13, Sec. III.B (S5), Table II

pipeline.step: probabilistic_client_audit
pipeline.input: client submissions: PEFT updates, sparse local proofs, local quota commitments
pipeline.output: coverage certificate (q% of steps verified with confidence bounds) and anomaly flags
pipeline.source: Sec. III.J.a, Sec. IV.D.e, Table V

pipeline.step: accept_or_exclude_update
pipeline.input: verification and audit outcomes
pipeline.output: accepted update set or exclusion of tainted client updates; aggregation aborted on quota violation

params.rule: hard error on any violation; exclude until the client attests a corrected manifest

pipeline.source: Sec. IV.C.a, Sec. V.G.b, Sec. III.L.a

quotes.supports: step 1 commit_dataset (Merkle commitment over per-example digests)
quotes.text: We build cD as a Merkle tree over leaves li = H(xi ∥yi ∥metai), where metai captures source, license, and preprocessing digest.

quotes.supports: steps 4-5 verifiable public sampling and membership paths
quotes.text: In public sampling, batch index i ∈It is re-derived from (s, t) by a CSPRNG; the trainer reveals Merkle paths path(i) to show li is included.

quotes.supports: step 6 quota_linear_check (selection indicator and binning matrix of Eq. (3))
quotes.text: Let et ∈{0, 1}|D| be the indicator of selected indices at step t, and M be an attribute matrix mapping examples to bins.

quotes.supports: step 7 fixed_point_project (Eq. (5) scaling and overflow range proofs)
quotes.text: Proof systems work over finite fields Fp. We map reals to fixed-point with scale S = 2b, so ⌊Sx⌉∈Z fits into the field; overflows are ruled out by range proofs.

quotes.supports: step 8 softmax_lookup_approx (Eq. (4) bounded approximation error)
quotes.text: For example, we approximate softmax(z) with a rational/polynomial f sm(z) over a clipped range using lookup tables with bounded interpolation error δsm.

quotes.supports: step 10 lora_forward_with_frozen_hash (adapter subspace restricted by frozen-tensor hash equality)
quotes.text: To constrain training to the adapter subspace, we hash frozen tensors and enforce equality constraints to public commitments.

quotes.supports: steps 13-15 optimizer state commitment, AdamW transition and hash chain
quotes.text: We commit to (mt, vt) using Merkle accumulators or polynomial commitments and link consecutive steps with a hash chain. The step circuit verifies the transition in Eq. (2) under fixed hyperparameters.

quotes.supports: step 17 recursive_fold (recursion circuit R folding two child proofs)
quotes.text: Step proofs πt are folded via a recursion circuit R that consumes two child proofs and outputs their aggregate. We use a cycle of curves or a proof system with native recursion to keep verification native to the field.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：探针挂载位置，模块输入隐状态先经 LoRA 下投影进入 r 维瓶颈
quotes.text: The hidden state h entering the module is first projected into a low-dimensional bottleneck by the LoRA down-projection Am, and the resulting bottleneck representation is then mapped back to the output dimension by the LoRA up-projection Bm.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2：尖峰统计量的语义，激活幅度大且集中在少数 token 位置时 s_m(x) 大
quotes.text: Here, sm(x) is large when an insertion site exhibits both high activation magnitude and strong localization to a small number of prompt-token positions.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：在干净集上为每个插入点计算 s_m 并得到站点专属 μ_m 与 σ_m
quotes.text: For each insertion site m, LoRAScan computes the activation spike statistic sm(ci) on every clean prompt. These clean scores define a site-specific mean µm and standard deviation σm.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：按 σ_m 升序排序并保留方差最小的比例 k
quotes.text: Specifically, LoRAScan ranks insertion sites by ascending σm and retains the lowest-variability fraction k, denoted Mk.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：跨插入点标准化以统一尺度，再平均得到提示级分数 S_k(x)
quotes.text: This normalization places spike statistics from different insertion sites on a common scale. The resulting score Sk(x) measures how anomalous the prompt is relative to the clean behavior of the monitored LoRA insertion sites.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：用干净分数的中位数与 MAD 构造单边上尾阈值 τ_k
quotes.text: Let bmk be the median of these scores, and let bdk be their median absolute deviation. The rejection threshold is defined as τk = bmk + λbdk

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：单次前向算 S_k(x)，超阈值则在生成前拒绝，否则走原始生成
quotes.text: At inference time, LoRAScan performs a single forward pass, computes Sk(x), and rejects the prompt before generation if Sk(x) > τk. Otherwise, the prompt is passed to the LoRA-adapted model for normal generation.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3、4、6 的参考数据规模与超参数取值（n=40、k=0.05、λ=4.45）
quotes.text: LoRAScan uses a clean set of 40 prompts sampled from the Stanford Alpaca dataset (Taori et al. 2023). These prompts are used only to select LoRA insertion sites to monitor and set the rejection threshold.

method: CHORUS

pipeline.step: 数据划分与探针池构建
pipeline.input: 节点私有指令微调数据 D_i（每节点 4000 条 ALPACA / 2000 条 DOLLY-15K）
pipeline.output: 训练集 D^tr_i 与 held-out probe pool D^pr_i（160 条，演示与查询各半）

pipeline.step: 抽取并固定探针触发词
pipeline.input: 公开的 10000 个 5–12 字母英文词表
pipeline.output: τ_i（整个 run 固定，无需等于攻击者 trigger τ*）

pipeline.step: 构建并固定 Stage 1a 探针 prompt
pipeline.input: D^pr_i、τ_i、固定拒答示范串 y_ref、固定随机种子
pipeline.output: 整个 run 复用的 P 条 prompt：两条普通示例 + 一条『触发指令→拒答』示例 + 带 τ_i 的 query

params.seed: 固定（论文未给具体数值）
params.refusal_demo: I'm sorry, but as an AI assistant, I do not have the capability to follow the given instruction.

pipeline.step: 本地训练得到本轮中间适配器
pipeline.input: θ^t_i（LoRA rank 8、α_LoRA=16）与 D^tr_i

pipeline.step: 广播并接收邻居适配器

params.graph: 双向图 G(V,E)，主实验 n=16 的 3-regular circulant

pipeline.step: 筛选本轮要 screening 的邻居
pipeline.input: 信任状态 {S_j}_{j∈View(i)}
pipeline.output: 本轮 screening 的邻居集合；接受集合 A 置空

params.skip_condition: S_j = EJECTED 且未到 W_re 轮 re-check

pipeline.step: Stage 1a：探测接收适配器的拒答率
pipeline.input: θ^{t+1/2}_j、τ_i、D^pr_i、y_ref、P 条固定 prompt
pipeline.output: 标量得分 s_{i→j} ∈ [0,1]

pipeline.step: 与同一发送者的其它接收者交换探针分数
pipeline.input: s_{i→j}
pipeline.output: 池化得分 V_j = {s_{k→j}}_{k∈R_j}，R_j ⊆ View(j) 为尚未 EJECTED j 的接收者（含 i）

pipeline.step: Stage 1a 判定：严格多数投票
pipeline.input: V_j、η
pipeline.output: 布尔 reject_P

params.rule: n_flag > |R_j|/2；平局接受

pipeline.step: Stage 1b：采集候选字符串
pipeline.input: θ^{t+1/2}_j、τ_i、D^pr_i、合规答案 y_c、H、B、L；跨轮缓冲 B_{i→j} 与计数表 C_{i→j}
pipeline.output: 更新后的 C_{i→j}（字符串→跨轮累计计数）与缓冲

params.beam: width 16, length penalty 1, early stopping, 只取 top beam

pipeline.step: Stage 1b：与共同接收者交换候选字符串
pipeline.input: C_{i→j}
pipeline.output: 池化计数表 C_j（按字符串把各接收者计数求和）

pipeline.step: Stage 1b：选出待测候选串
pipeline.input: C_j、K
pipeline.output: Y_j（计数最高的 K−1 条 ∪ 最长串 y^max_j，至多 K 条）

pipeline.step: Stage 1b：可移动性打分
pipeline.input: 被评分适配器 θ（θ_i 或 θ_j）、候选串 y、D^pr_i、τ_i、P
pipeline.output: 标量 Δ_i(θ,y)

params.pairing: θ_i 与 θ_j 共用同一批 prompt 与同一顺序 π

pipeline.step: Stage 1b：通用片段过滤与参考检查
pipeline.input: Y_j、θ_i、Δ_i(θ_i,y)、φ
pipeline.output: 过滤后的候选串集合；若参考不可用则本轮跳过 j

pipeline.step: Stage 1b：可移动性比值判定
pipeline.input: Δ_i(θ_j,y)、Δ_i(θ_i,y)
pipeline.output: 布尔 reject_Δ

params.rule: ∃y: r_j(y)=Δ_i(θ_j,y)/Δ_i(θ_i,y) < c

pipeline.step: 合并两测试判定并更新逐邻居信任状态机
pipeline.input: reject_P、reject_Δ、S_j
pipeline.output: 新状态 S_j（TRUSTED/SUSPECTED/EJECTED）与本轮是否接受 j

pipeline.step: 等权聚合被接受的适配器
pipeline.input: θ^{t+1/2}_i 与 {θ^{t+1/2}_j}_{j∈A}，A = {j: ¬reject 且 S_j = TRUSTED}

params.reject_edges: 丢弃后重新归一，仅保持行随机

sampling.how: 只用节点私有的留出探针池；Stage 1a 每次判定 30 条固定 prompt，Stage 1b 每轮每发送者 5 条采集生成，movability 用 30 对 prompt
sampling.size: 探针池 160 条（演示/查询各半）；P=30；H=5

sampling.how: 主实验 16 个节点、3-regular circulant 图、1 个攻击者，每个适配器由其距离 2 内的其它接收者共同 screening；评分单位是有向边×轮
sampling.size: n=16，度 3，m=1；每 seed 72 条恶意边-轮与 1008 条诚实边-轮

sampling.how: 论文未使用：CHORUS 不做层或权重的子采样（使用 30% 最大幅度坐标的是 ALIGNINS 基线，Appendix B.1）
论文未使用：CHORUS 完全在行为/文本层面判决
采集缓冲最近 W_h 轮的 W_h·H 条生成；候选计数跨轮累加且从不清零；SUSPECTED 窗口 W_ej；EJECTED 每 W_re 轮 re-check
sampling.size: W_h=10（=50 条生成）、W_ej=5、W_re=10、总轮数 R=24

quotes.supports: 步骤 2：Stage 1a 探针 prompt 构造
quotes.text: Node i then builds P prompts from its probe pool Dpr i , each holding (i) two ordinary instruction–response examples, (ii) a third one that pairs an instruction including τi with a refusal, and (iii) a query that also carries τi

quotes.supports: 步骤 7–8：分数交换与严格多数投票
quotes.text: node i sends the single scalar si→j to the other receivers of j and pools theirs in return. MAJORITYVOTE (line 8) rejects j when a strict majority of the pooled scores Vj exceeds η.

quotes.supports: 步骤 9：用合规答案采集候选串
quotes.text: Node i prompts θj as in Stage 1a, but with a compliant answer in place of the refusal demonstration (Figure 4, right). Nothing in this context teaches refusal, so any refusal comes from θj’s weights

quotes.supports: 步骤 12：可移动性 Δ_i(θ,y) 的定义
quotes.text: We define the movability score of θ on y, given by ∆i(θ, y), as the average gain in ℓθ when y is demonstrated in the prompt’s context compared to when it’s not

quotes.supports: 步骤 13：以最长串为参考的通用片段过滤
quotes.text: Node i thus discards every y with ∆i(θi, y) < ϕ ∆i(θi, ymax j ) for a fraction ϕ (Table 4), taking the longest string as reference because it is the least likely to be generic.

quotes.supports: 步骤 14：可移动性比值拒绝规则
quotes.text: MOVABILITYTEST rejects θj if at least one y satisfies rj(y) < c for a fixed hyperparameter c (Table 4).

quotes.supports: 步骤 15：信任状态机与停止并入
quotes.text: A TRUSTED neighbor becomes SUSPECTED after ksus consecutive rejections, at which point node i stops merging its adapters.

quotes.supports: 步骤 16：接受集合上的等权平均
quotes.text: Node i aggregates its own adapter with those it accepts this round, by averaging with equal weights (Algorithm 1, line 17).

method: 安全指令微调（safety instruction tuning）：用 GPT-3.5-turbo 把 Anthropic Red Teaming 的 2,000 条红队问题改写成指令并生成安全（多为拒绝）回复，人工复核后取 100/300/500/1000/1500/2000 条混入 20,000 条 Alpaca 通用指令数据，再用 LoRA 在 LLaMA 7B/13B 与 Falcon 7B 上微调 4 个 epoch。

pipeline.step: 抽样红队问题
pipeline.input: Anthropic Red Teaming Dataset 的问题-回复对（原始总量论文未说明）
pipeline.output: 2,000 条红队问题

pipeline.step: 问题改写成指令
pipeline.input: 2,000 条红队问题（英文问句）
pipeline.output: 2,000 条与原问题一一对应的指令

params.prompt: Appendix C.1 的固定 prompt + 4 个 few-shot 例子

pipeline.step: 生成安全回复
pipeline.input: 2,000 条红队问题
pipeline.output: 2,000 条安全回复（大多数为拒答），构成 instruction-response 对

pipeline.step: 人工复核过滤
pipeline.input: GPT-3.5-turbo 生成的指令-回复对
pipeline.output: 通过审查的安全指令-回复样本池

pipeline.step: 通用数据抽样与安全数据混合
pipeline.input: Alpaca-cleaned 的 20,000 条随机通用指令 + N 条安全指令
pipeline.output: 规模 20,000 + N 的混合 instruction-response 训练集

pipeline.input: 混合训练集，按 Appendix B.1 模板拼接并截断到 512 token，micro-batch 4、梯度累积到 batch 128
pipeline.output: LoRA adapter checkpoint（每个评估点一份）

pipeline.step: 验证损失选点
pipeline.input: 从训练集随机抽出的 500 条验证样本
pipeline.output: 验证损失最优的单一 checkpoint

pipeline.step: 评测回复生成
pipeline.input: 7 个评测集：I-MaliciousInstructions 100、I-CoNa 178、I-Controversial 40、Q-Harm 100、I-PhysicalSafety 100、XSTest 50、I-Alpaca 50
pipeline.output: 每个模型 × 每个数据集的回复集合

pipeline.step: 危害性奖励模型打分
pipeline.input: 模型对评测指令的回复文本
pipeline.output: 每条回复的 0–4 危害分

params.helpfulness_aug: 另加 2k OpenAssistant helpfulness 样本作 0 类（Appendix D.3）

pipeline.step: 内容审核取最大分
pipeline.input: 模型回复文本
pipeline.output: 每条回复的 [0,1] 不安全分

pipeline.step: 拒绝前缀匹配
pipeline.input: 模型回复文本
pipeline.output: 是否拒绝的布尔值与计数/比例

pipeline.step: 通用能力与夸张安全评测
pipeline.input: BoolQ / OpenBookQA / PIQA 的测试样本、AlpacaEval 前 300 条、XSTest 50 条、I-Alpaca 50 条
pipeline.output: 准确率、对 text-davinci-003 的胜率、未夸张安全比例

pipeline.step: 聚合 LoRA 适配器（分析补充，论文未涉及）

pipeline.output: 全局 LoRA adapter

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 问题改写成指令所用的构造方式
quotes.text: Our training set has been constructed by transforming the questions in Ganguli et al. (2022) into instructions. We transform them using the following prompt for ChatGPT:

quotes.supports: 步骤 1 抽样红队问题与步骤 3 生成安全回复
quotes.text: We randomly selected 2,000 questions from this dataset and used GPT-3.5-turbo to generate “safe” responses to them. A majority of these responses were rejections to the posed red teaming queries.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 的指令改写与步骤 4 的人工复核过滤
quotes.text: We conducted a manual review of these generated responses to confirm their safety and appropriateness. Meanwhile, we turned all questions into instructions using GPT-3.5-turbo

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 通用指令数据的来源
quotes.text: We take as reference data for our general-purpose instruction tuning the Alpaca (Taori et al., 2023) dataset, in its cleaned version.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 的 20k 通用样本与可变安全样本混合
quotes.text: We augmented a random sample of 20,000 instructions from the Alpaca dataset with varying numbers of safety instructions so that we could study the effects of the amount of safety data added.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6 的 LoRA 微调轮数与步骤 7 的验证损失选点
quotes.text: All models are finetuned using low-rank adaptation (LoRA) (Hu et al., 2022) for four epochs. We pick the best checkpoint considering validation loss by evaluating every 50 steps with a batch size of 128.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6 的 epoch、梯度累积、批大小与学习率
quotes.text: We train for 4 epochs, using gradient accumulation (batch size of 128, micro-batch size of 4). The learning rate is set to 1e-4 for all models.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6 的 LoRA 超参与目标模块
quotes.text: The parameters for low-rank adaptations are as follows. Alpha is 16, dropout is set to 0.05 and r is set to 4. Target modules for LLaMA models are [q_proj,v_proj].

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：服务器侧确定性选择函数 F 的定义（聚合位置）
quotes.text: The parameter server computes a vector F(V t 1 , . . . , V t n) by applying a deterministic function F to the vectors received. We refer to F as the choice function of the parameter server.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：未收到的向量按默认值 0 填充
quotes.text: Note that, since the communication is synchronous, if the parameter server does not receive a vector value V t b from a given Byzantine worker b, then the parameter server acts as if it had received the default value V t b = 0 instead.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：i → j 表示 V_j 属于 V_i 的 n−f−2 个最近邻
quotes.text: For any i ̸= j, we denote by i →j the fact that Vj belongs to the n −f −2 closest vectors to Vi.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：分数为最近邻平方距离之和
quotes.text: Then, we define for each worker i, the score s(i) = P i→j ∥Vi −Vj∥2 where the sum runs over the n −f −2 closest vectors to Vi.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：取最小分数者的下标 i*
quotes.text: Finally, Kr(V1, . . . , Vn) = Vi∗ where i∗ refers to the worker minimizing the score, s(i∗) ≤s(i) for all i.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7 的并列处理：取标识符最小的 worker
quotes.text: If two or more workers have the minimal score, we choose the vector of the worker with the smallest identifier.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4–5：计算 n 个平方距离、排序并取前 n−f−1 个值（复杂度分解）
quotes.text: For each Vi, the parameter server computes the n squared distances ∥Vi −Vj∥2 (time O(n·d)). Then the parameter server sorts these distances (time O(n·log n)) and sums the first n−f −1 values (time O(n·d)).

quotes.supports: 步骤 9：m-Krum 的迭代删除与重复选择
quotes.text: This can be achieved, for instance, by selecting one vector using the Krum function, removing it from the list, and iterating this scheme m −1 times, as long as n −m > 2f + 2.

method: FLTrust: the server bootstraps trust from a small clean root dataset; each local model update is scored by its ReLU-clipped cosine similarity to the server model update and rescaled to the server update's L2 norm, then averaged with trust-score weights to form the global model update.

pipeline.step: per-round client sampling and broadcast of the global model
pipeline.input: global model w (d-dim); client pool of size n
pipeline.output: w delivered to tau sampled clients
pipeline.source: Algorithm 2 line 4; Section II-A Step I; Section VI-A-4

pipeline.step: client local SGD on its own data
pipeline.input: w; local dataset Di; batch size b; local learning rate beta; local iterations Rl
pipeline.output: local model update gi = w_R - w, tau vectors of dimension d

pipeline.step: server-side reference SGD on the clean root dataset
pipeline.input: same-round w; root dataset D0; same b, beta, Rl
pipeline.output: server model update g0 (d-dim)
pipeline.source: Algorithm 2 line 12; Section IV-A; Section IV-C

pipeline.step: cosine similarity between each local update and the server update
pipeline.input: gi for i=1..tau and g0, all d-dim

pipeline.step: ReLU clipping of cosine similarity into trust score
pipeline.input: ci
pipeline.output: TSi = max(ci, 0)

pipeline.step: rescale each local update to the server update's L2 norm
pipeline.output: gbar_i = (||g0||/||gi||)*gi with ||gbar_i|| = ||g0||

pipeline.step: trust-score weighted average of the normalized updates
pipeline.input: pairs (TSi, gbar_i) for i=1..tau
pipeline.output: global model update g (d-dim)

pipeline.step: global model update with the global learning rate
pipeline.input: w, g, alpha
pipeline.output: w + alpha*g (new global model)

params.alpha_beta: 3e-4, 6e-3, 2e-4, 3e-3, 3e-4 (0.9 decay at rounds 1500 and 1750 for one setting)

sampling.how: randomly sample tau of the n clients in each global iteration (with or without replacement not stated)

server draws a random batch Db from the clean root dataset D0 during its SGD; the root dataset itself is sampled from the union of clients' clean data, uniformly in Case I or class-biased with a bias probability in Case II
sampling.size: |D0| = 100 by default (Table I; Section VI-A-5); swept 50-500 in Figure 4; bias probability 0.1-1.0 in Table V

sampling.how: fixed number of global iterations, no per-round subsampling and no early stopping

resources: clean root dataset D0 collected and manually labeled by the service provider (default 100 examples; Section III; Section VI-A-5)
one extra model replica on the server (server model, fine-tuned from the global model with the same optimizer settings; Section IV-A)
global model w and its dimension d (the bound in Theorem 1 depends on d and |D0|)
root dataset examples must be excluded from clients' local training data (Section VI-A-5)
no pretrained detector, no extra network, no client-side extra data or computation (Section III; Section VI-B)
dominant_cost: Reported: no extra client computation or communication; the server's extra work is one root-dataset model update plus tau cosine similarities and tau rescalings, negligible for a powerful server (Section VI-B). Analysis: per round the server pays O(Rl * |D0|) forward/backward passes on the root dataset plus O(tau * d) for scoring and rescaling, growing with |D0|, Rl, tau and d; client cost is unchanged from FedAvg.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：每轮客户端采样与 Rl = 1 的设置
quotes.text: Following previous work [15], we set τ = n, i.e., all clients are selected in each iteration; and we set Rl = 1

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 与步骤 3：客户端更新与服务器更新同一套 ModelUpdate 参数
quotes.text: The local model updates and the server model update are computed by the function ModelUpdate in Algorithm 1 via performing stochastic gradient descent for Rl iterations with a local learning rate β.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：服务器用根数据集计算服务器模型更新 g0
quotes.text: Meanwhile, the server itself computes the server model update based on the global model and the root dataset.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4-5：信任分定义为 ReLU 截断的余弦相似度
quotes.text: Formally, our trust score of a local model update is its ReLU-clipped cosine similarity with the server model update.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：为什么余弦为负的更新必须被截断
quotes.text: However, the cosine similarity alone is insufficient because a local model update, whose cosine similarity score is negative, can still have a negative impact on the aggregated global model update.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：范数对齐到服务器更新的超球面及其作用
quotes.text: Such normalization essentially projects each local model update to the same hyper-sphere where the server model update lies in the vector space, which limits the impact of the poisoned local model updates with large magnitudes.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7-8：信任分加权平均得到全局模型更新并更新全局模型
quotes.text: Finally, FLTrust computes the average of the normalized local model updates weighted by their trust scores as the global model update, which is used to update the global model.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3 与外部资源：根数据集规模
quotes.text: Our FLTrust requires a small root dataset. By default, we assume the root dataset has only 100 training examples.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1、2：训练可疑模型并用训练数据查询取得最后隐层激活
quotes.text: First, the neural network is trained using untrusted data that potentially includes poisonous samples. Then, the network is queried using the training data and the resulting activations of the last hidden layer are retained.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：按标签分段、逐类聚类
quotes.text: Once the activations are obtained for each training sample, they are segmented according to their label and each segment clustered separately.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：展平成 1D 后用 ICA 降维
quotes.text: To cluster the activations, we first reshaped the activations into a 1D vector and then performed dimensionality reduction using Independent Component Analysis (ICA), which was found to be more effective than Principle Component Analysis (PCA).

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：k = 2 的 k-means 聚类
quotes.text: After dimensionality reduction, we found k-means with k = 2 to be highly effective at separating the poisonous from legitimate activations.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：ExRe 的排除重训与重分类
quotes.text: Our first cluster analysis method involves training a new model without the data corresponding to the cluster(s) in question. Once the new model is trained, we use it to classify the removed cluster(s).

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：相对大小判定
quotes.text: Thus, when p% of the data with a given label is poisoned, we expect that one cluster contains roughly p% of the data, while the other cluster contains roughly (100 −p)% of the data.

quotes.supports: 步骤 8：轮廓系数阈值 0.10-0.15
quotes.text: Otherwise, our experiments on MNIST, LISA and Rotten Tomatoes datasets indicate that a threshold between .10 and .15 is reasonable.

quotes.supports: 步骤 11：重标注源类并继续训练修复
quotes.text: A faster option, however, is to relabel the poisonous data with its source class and continue to train the model on these samples until it converges again.

quotes.supports: step 1-3: the core mechanism that input-agnostic triggers keep predictions constant under strong perturbation
quotes.text: The key insight is that, regardless of strong perturbations on the input image, the predictions of all perturbed inputs tend to be always consistent, falling into the attacker's targeted class.

quotes.supports: step 1 and step 3: perturbed inputs are superimposed with an image randomly drawn from the user held-out dataset and fed to the deployed model
quotes.text: The perturbation step generates N perturbed inputs {xp1, ......, xpN } corresponding to one given incoming input x. Each perturbed input is a superimposed image of both the input x (replica) and an image randomly drawn from the user held-out dataset, Dtest.

quotes.supports: step 2: linear blend implementation detail
quotes.text: The perturbation considered in this work is image linear blend—superimposing two images 2. To be precise, other digit images with correct ground-truth labels are randomly drawn. Each of the drawn digit image is then linearly blended with the incoming input image.

quotes.supports: step 4: per-perturbation Shannon entropy formula (Eq 2)
quotes.text: Starting from the nth perturbed input xpn ∈ {xp1, ......, xpN }, its entropy Hn can be expressed: Hn = − i=M X i=1 yi × log2 yi (2)

quotes.supports: step 5: entropy summation over the perturbation set and its interpretation (Eq 3)
quotes.text: Based on the entropy Hn of each perturbed input xpn, the entropy summation of all N perturbed inputs {xp1, ......, xpN } is: Hsum = n=N X n=1 Hn (3) with Hsum standing for the chance the input x being trojaned.

quotes.supports: step 6: detection boundary is the percentile of the benign entropy normal distribution at the preset FRR
quotes.text: Firstly, FRR, e.g., 1%, of a detection system is determined. Then the percentile of the normal distribution is calculated. This percentile is chosen as the detection boundary.

quotes.supports: step 7: threshold semantics and where FAR comes from
quotes.text: Consequentially, the FAR is the probability that the entropy of an incoming trojaned input is larger than this detection boundary.

quotes.supports: section 8 cost: N extra predictions and the measured 1.32x time overhead
quotes.text: To be speciﬁc, processing time—generating N = 10 perturbed images—takes 0.1ms, while predicting 10 images takes 6.025ms 3. In total, STRIP detection overhead is 6.125ms, whereas the original inference time without implementing STRIP is 4.63ms.

method: Safe LoRA：用对齐模型与未对齐模型的逐层权重差构造安全对齐子空间，把与投影结果余弦相似度低于阈值（或相似度最低的 top-K）的那些 LoRA 层的更新 ΔW=AB^T 替换为子空间投影，从而在微调后修补安全对齐

pipeline.step: 构造对齐矩阵 V
pipeline.input: 第 i 层的未对齐模型权重 W_i^unaligned 与对齐模型权重 W_i^aligned（同架构同形状，论文按 n×n 权重空间讨论）
pipeline.output: V_i = W_i^aligned − W_i^unaligned，每层一个矩阵

pipeline.step: 构造精确投影矩阵 Ĉ
pipeline.input: V_i
pipeline.output: Ĉ_i = V_i (V_i^T V_i)^{-1} V_i^T
pipeline.source: 公式 (2)，Section 3.1；每层需要一次 (V^T V)^{-1}

pipeline.step: 构造快速近似投影矩阵 C（与上一步二选一）
pipeline.input: V_i
pipeline.output: C_i = V_i V_i^T / ||V_i||_F（Frobenius 范数归一）
pipeline.source: Section 3.4；Figure 1 代码 C = np.dot(V, V.T())/np.norm(V)

pipeline.step: 计算投影后的 LoRA 更新
pipeline.input: LoRA 第 i 层更新 ΔW_i = A_i B_i^T 与投影矩阵 Ĉ_i（或 C_i）
pipeline.output: Ĉ_i ΔW_i（与 ΔW_i 同形状的稠密矩阵）

pipeline.step: 计算逐层余弦相似度
pipeline.input: ΔW_i 与 Ĉ_i ΔW_i
pipeline.output: 标量 cos_i = ⟨ΔW_i, Ĉ_iΔW_i⟩_F / (||ΔW_i||_F ||Ĉ_iΔW_i||_F)
pipeline.source: 公式 (3) 的条件式；Figure 1 的 cos(CΔW, ΔW)；Figure 4 纵轴

pipeline.step: 按相似度选层
pipeline.input: 所有 LoRA 层的 cos_i
pipeline.output: 待投影层集合（cos_i < τ 的层，或 cos 最低的 top-K 层）

quotes.supports: 步骤 0/1：获取未对齐与对齐模型对并构造对齐矩阵 V
quotes.text: First, we assume access to a pair of unaligned and aligned LLM weights, denoted as Wunaligned and Waligned, which are often available for open-source LLMs such as Llama Base (unaligned) and Chat (aligned) models.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2：构造精确投影矩阵 Ĉ = V(V^T V)^{-1}V^T
quotes.text: After obtaining Vi, we perform matrix multiplication with Vi and its transpose with the matrix (ViT Vi)−1 to form a standard projection matrix. This operation is conducted on a layer-wise basis

quotes.supports: 步骤 2'/3：快速近似投影算子 C = VV^T/||V||_F 与相似度计算
quotes.text: we use the projection operator C = VVT /∥V∥F to calculate the similarity score between the projected LoRA weights CABT and the original LoRA weights ABT

quotes.supports: 步骤 4/5：用相似度阈值决定投影哪些层
quotes.text: Instead, we calculate the similarity between the original and projected LoRA weights, i.e., ∆Wi and Ci∆Wi. Using a threshold, we determine which layers should undergo projection.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：top-K 最低相似度层的替代选层规则
quotes.text: Alternatively, τ could be selected such that only the top-K layers with the lowest similarity scores will be projected.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7'：全参数微调变体投影残差（公式 (4)）
quotes.text: Instead of directly projecting the weights of the fine-tuned model, we project the residual weights between the pre-trained and fine-tuned models.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 的开销对比：精确版远比近似版慢
quotes.text: It takes 8.6 × 10−3 seconds to generate C, while generating ˆC requires 2.1714 seconds, denoting a 250x times slower generation speed.

quotes.supports: 资源与实现：对齐矩阵存磁盘并逐层载入 GPU
quotes.text: In practice, the alignment does require hardware resources, but it doesn't utilize GPUs. Instead, it can be stored on disk. During projection, it is loaded layer by layer onto GPUs (not all at once)

quotes.supports: Step 1: the four task ingredients and the guideline content
quotes.text: For input-output safeguarding tasks, we identify the following four key ingredients. A set of guidelines. Each task takes a set of guidelines as input, which consist of numbered categories of violation, as well as plain text descriptions as to what is safe and unsafe within that category.

quotes.supports: Step 3 and Step 5: single-token safe/unsafe output and the newline plus violated-category list
quotes.text: First, the model should output “safe” or “unsafe”, both of which are single tokens in the SentencePiece tokenizer that we use (Kudo and Richardson, 2018). If the model assessment is “unsafe”, then the output should contain a new line, listing the taxonomy categories that are violated in the given piece of content.

quotes.supports: Step 4 and Step 5: reading the score from the first token and the 1-vs-all variant
quotes.text: With this output format, Llama Guard accommodates binary and multi-label classification, where the classifier score can be read off from the probability of the first token. The same format allows for 1 vs. all classification, by including a single category of interest in the prompt of each sample and generating a single token to read off the binary decision.

quotes.supports: Step 2: few-shot setup, 2 to 4 examples per category, hard negatives
quotes.text: Few-shot prompting is similar to zero-shot but additionally includes 2 to 4 examples for each category in the prompt. The learning happens in-context, i.e., we do not train on these examples. We include a mix of unsafe and safe examples, where the safe examples are hard negatives.

quotes.supports: Step 4: the definition of the per-category 1-vs-all prediction task
quotes.text: Per-category binary classification via 1-vs-all. In this setting, we run one prediction task tk per category ck in the target taxonomy such that: only the ck is considered as positive for task tk. All other samples including the true negatives and samples from other categories cj ̲= k are considered as negatives.

quotes.supports: Step 2: empirical finding that prompt-only adaptation is effective and cheap
quotes.text: We find that adapting to a new policy exclusively through prompting is effective while also being low cost compared to fine-tuning. Table 4 compares binary classification performance of Llama Guard and OpenAI’s approach (Markov et al., 2023) on the OpenAI moderation test set under different prompt adaptations.

quotes.supports: Step 4: how the single category of interest is injected at inference for per-category scoring
quotes.text: As mentioned in Section 3.1, we do this by only including the category of interest (ck) in the model input instructions. Per-category binary classification via 1-vs-benign.

quotes.supports: Training-side data construction: keeping only the first human prompt and generating cooperating/refusing responses
quotes.text: From this dataset, we pick the first human prompt and discard the corresponding response from the assistant, as well as all the other turns to create an initial single-turn prompt dataset. Next, we use one of our internal Llama checkpoints to generate a mix of cooperating and refusing responses for these prompts.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1：把所有模型的权重/偏置按同一预定顺序展平
quotes.text: we represent Neural Networks (NNs) using their weight vectors, in which the extraction of weights is done identically for all models by flattening/serializing the weight/bias matrices in a predetermined order

quotes.supports: 步骤 2-3：两两余弦距离 + HDBSCAN 聚类
quotes.text: FLAME uses pairwise cosine distances to measure the angular differences between all model updates and applies the HDBSCAN clustering algorithm [13].

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：min_cluster_size 取 n/2+1，保证多数簇为多数更新
quotes.text: we set the minimum cluster size to be at least 50% of the clients, i.e., n/2 + 1, so that the resulting cluster will contain the majority of updates

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：离群点即被剔除，且能处理多个同时注入的后门
quotes.text: In particular, HDBSCAN labels models as outliers if they do not fit into any cluster. This allows FLAME to effectively handle multiple poisoned models with different backdoors by labeling them as outliers.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：裁剪边界的中位数必须基于全部 n 个模型（含被剔除者）
quotes.text: It should be noted that for determining the clipping bound, the rejected models are also considered to ensure that even if benign models were filtered, the computed median St is still determined based on benign values.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：裁剪公式与逐坐标乘法
quotes.text: Clipping scales down model updates as follows: W c bl = Gt-1 +(Wbl -Gt-1)* MIN(1,gamma) (detailed in line 8-11 of Alg. 1) where the multiplication is computed coordinate-wise.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：等权聚合，不使用客户端数据集大小
quotes.text: Hence, we follow common practice in literature and weight the contributions of all clients equally regardless of their dataset size

quotes.supports: 步骤 8：epsilon 与 lambda 的取值
quotes.text: We use standard DP parameters and set epsilon = 3705 for IC, epsilon = 395 for the NIDS and epsilon = 4191 for the NLP scenario. Accordingly, lambda = 0.001 for IC and NLP

quotes.supports: 步骤 1 选定观测模块
quotes.text: As suggested in [57], the parameters of the deeper layers tend to amplify the divergence of the gradients in the frequency space. Thus, we use the parameters of the lora_B in the last transformer layer as the target module.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 逐样本反向传播
quotes.text: To filter out poisoned samples, once the global model is received from the server, each client uses local private data to do single-sample backpropagation.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3 二维 DCT 与频域特征
quotes.text: Specifically, a robust representation ˆg can be obtained for clustering to filter out poisoned samples by applying 2D discrete cosine transformation (2D-DCT) to the sample-wise gradients g ∈RM×N, as illustrated in Equation 5

quotes.supports: 步骤 4 UMAP 降到二维
quotes.text: In order to enhance the distinction between different sample features and make clustering algorithms perform better, we use UMAP to reduce the features to two dimensions.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 双聚类集成
quotes.text: we use hierarchical clustering with the number of clusters two (the primary cluster and the secondary cluster) and HDBSCAN (the number of clusters is determined by the algorithm) to perform clustering, respectively

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 轮廓系数门控与全部视为干净的回退
quotes.text: the smaller one of the two silhouette scores is less than ts = 0.2 and larger one is less than tl = 0.4 (which is considered as weak plausibility), all data are considered clean data to reduce FP misjudgment.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6 与步骤 9 用原始频域维度计算质心
quotes.text: We choose to use the center of the original frequency domain dimension of the samples in the main cluster as the local centroid.

quotes.supports: 步骤 8 服务器二次聚类取主簇
quotes.text: Once the server receives the centroids from all clients, it will cluster the centroids again and select the main cluster, which has the most samples, to calculate the global centroid.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 原句困惑度；运行位置为推理期、送入受害模型之前
quotes.text: In the inference process of a backdoored model, for a given test sample (sentence) comprising n words s = w1, · · · , wn, we first use a language model to calculate its perplexity p0.

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 的语言模型选型（外部资源）
quotes.text: In this paper, we choose the widely used GPT-2 pre-trained language model (Radford et al., 2019), which has demonstrated powerful performance on many NLP tasks.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3 与步骤 4 的怀疑分数定义（公式 1）
quotes.text: Then we define the suspicion score of a word as the decrements of sentence perplexity after removing the word, namely fi = p0 −pi, (1) where pi is the perplexity of the sentence without wi

quotes.supports: 步骤 4 的分数方向解释（fi 大意味着离群词）
quotes.text: That is because if wi is an outlier word, removing it would considerably decrease the perplexity of the sentence, and correspondingly fi = p0 −pi would be a large positive number.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 阈值判定与步骤 6 删词动作
quotes.text: We determine the words with a suspicion score larger than ts (i.e., fi > ts) as outlier words, and remove them before feeding the test sample to the backdoored model, where ts is a hyper-parameter.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1 在正常样本上调 ts 的准则
quotes.text: To avoid accidentally removing normal words and impairing model's performance, we can tune ts on some normal samples (e.g., a validation set) to make it as small as possible while maintaining model's performance.

quotes.supports: 步骤 1 的无验证集兜底 ts = 0
quotes.text: We also specially show the performance of ONION with ts = 0 on SST-2 (∆ASR' and ∆CACC'), simulating the situation where there is no validation set for tuning ts.

quotes.supports: 整条流水线的定位：测试样本检查、删词以防激活后门
quotes.text: This method is based on test sample examination, i.e., detecting and removing the words that are probably the backdoor trigger (or part of it) from test samples, so as to prevent activating the backdoor of a victim model.

quotes.supports: 步骤 8：本地交替更新机制（同一轮内轮流更新 A、B）
quotes.text: Instead of simultaneously updating both A and B, LA-LoRA adopts an alternating scheme, where the two low-rank matrices are updated in turn within each local training round.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：本地 mini-batch 抽样及采样率 b 与本地数据集规模 R
quotes.text: At each step k ∈[K] it samples a mini-batch Bi ⊂Di of size ⌊bR⌋. b is the local data sampling rate, R is the size of Di.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：只对当前活跃因子计算逐样本梯度（式 (8)，奇数步更新 B）
quotes.text: Odd steps (update B). For each example j ∈Bi, compute the per-example gradient gij = ∇B Li (W0 + sBt i,kAt i,k, di j ),

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 与步骤 6：逐样本 ℓ2 裁剪后批内求和并注入高斯噪声
quotes.text: Perform per-example ℓ2-norm clipping with threshold C: gij ←gij/ max{1, ∥gij∥2/C}. Aggregate over the mini-batch and inject Gaussian noise to ensure DP:

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：固定 5 抽头二项式高斯低通滤波核
quotes.text: Specifically, we adopt a fixed 1D Gaussian kernel Gs = 1/16[1, 4, 6, 4, 1], i.e., the standard 5-tap binomial low-pass filter.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：滤波作用轴为 A 逐行、B 逐列
quotes.text: For A ∈Rr×n, smoothing is applied row-wise along the input feature dimension; for B ∈Rm×r, smoothing is applied column-wise along the output dimension.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5：裁剪阈值的按层中位数实现
quotes.text: Gradient clipping is performed on a per-layer basis using a median clipping strategy, where each layer's clipping threshold C is set to the median of its gradient norm distribution

quotes.supports: 步骤 10：服务器对 A、B 分别平均并组装全局模型（式 (10)）
quotes.text: The server averages client uploads: At = 1/|Ct| X i∈Ct At i, Bt = 1/|Ct| X i∈Ct Bt i, and then updates the global model as W t = W0 + sBtAt.

method: DeepSight: 服务器端三层后门防御（过滤层 + 裁剪层 + 聚合层）；用 DDifs、NEUPs、Threshold Exceedings 特征做逐模型分类与 HDBSCAN 聚类集成，按簇投票剔除可疑簇，再对剩余更新做中位数范数裁剪与 FedAvg 聚合

pipeline.step: 提取输出层偏置更新
pipeline.input: N 个本地模型 W_{t,k} 与全局模型 G_t 的输出层偏置向量，各 P 维
pipeline.output: N 个 P 维偏置更新向量 Δb_k = b(W_{t,k}) - b(G_t)

pipeline.step: 成对余弦距离矩阵
pipeline.input: N 个 P 维偏置更新向量
pipeline.output: N×N 对称距离矩阵 d_cos(i,j) = 1 - COSINE(Δb_i, Δb_j)

pipeline.step: 归一化更新能量 NEUPs
pipeline.input: W_{t,k} 与 G_t 的输出层参数：偏置 b 与到上一层的权重 w（每个输出神经元 1 个偏置 + H 个权重）
pipeline.output: N 个 P 维 NEUP 向量 C_{t,k,i}

pipeline.step: 阈值超越计数 Threshold Exceedings
pipeline.input: N 个 P 维 NEUP 向量
pipeline.output: N 个整数 TE 值

pipeline.step: 中位数分类为良性/可疑
pipeline.input: N 个 TE 值
pipeline.output: N 个二值标签（1 = 可疑/投毒，0 = 良性）

params.rule: TE <= MEDIAN(TE)/2

pipeline.step: 随机探针前向
pipeline.input: 3 个种子各生成一个 20000 × input_dim 的随机输入矩阵
pipeline.output: 每个种子下 G_t 与各 W_{t,k} 的 20000 × P 输出层概率

pipeline.step: 除法差异 DDifs
pipeline.input: 同一批随机输入下本地模型与全局模型的输出层概率
pipeline.output: 3 × N × P 的 DDif 向量

pipeline.step: 逐特征 HDBSCAN 聚类
pipeline.input: N×N 余弦距离矩阵（precomputed distance）、N×P NEUP（values）、3 份 N×P DDif（values）
pipeline.output: 5 组簇标号（余弦 1 组、NEUP 1 组、DDif 3 组）

pipeline.step: 簇共现距离矩阵
pipeline.input: 一组簇标号
pipeline.output: N×N 的 0/1 距离矩阵（同簇为 0，否则为 1）

pipeline.step: 距离矩阵平均合并
pipeline.input: 3 个 DDif 距离矩阵、1 个 NEUP 距离矩阵、1 个余弦距离矩阵
pipeline.output: N×N 合并距离矩阵

pipeline.step: 在合并距离上再聚类
pipeline.input: N×N 合并距离矩阵
pipeline.output: 最终簇划分 clusters

pipeline.step: 簇投票过滤 PCI
pipeline.input: 最终簇划分 + 步骤 5 的二值标签
pipeline.output: 被接受的模型集合（整簇保留或整簇剔除）

params.rule: sum(labels in cluster)/|cluster| < tau 则接受整簇

pipeline.step: 裁剪到中位数范数
pipeline.input: 被接受的模型 W_{t,i} 与全局模型 G_t
pipeline.output: 裁剪后的更新 W'_{t,i} = (W_{t,i} - G_t) * λ + G_t

params.S: median of L2 norms of all updates (dynamic)

pipeline.step: FedAvg 等权聚合
pipeline.input: 过滤并裁剪后剩余的更新
pipeline.output: 新的全局模型 G_{t+1}

pipeline.step: 末轮按簇聚合与下发
pipeline.input: 簇划分 + 各簇内的模型（论文称还包括被过滤、被裁剪的模型）
pipeline.output: 每个簇一个聚合模型，客户端收到其所在簇的模型

method: SEAL: bilevel data selection that learns a softmax sample ranker sigma(omega) on top of a safety-aligned LLM, ranks the fine-tuning samples, keeps the top p% and fine-tunes on the selected subset

pipeline.step: initial_alignment: obtain a safety-aligned LLM theta_1 (S1)
pipeline.input: base/pre-trained LLM; preference or alignment data (for PYTHIA-2.8B: 112k subset of ANTHROPIC HH)
pipeline.output: safety-aligned model parameters theta_1

params.note: only needed for PYTHIA-2.8B; LLAMA-3-8B-INSTRUCT / MERLINITE-7B / LLAMA2-7B-CHAT-HF are used off the shelf

pipeline.step: selector_initialization: omega in R^N with softmax weights
pipeline.input: number of fine-tuning samples N
pipeline.output: omega in R^N and per-sample weights sigma_i(omega)=exp(omega_i)/sum_l exp(omega_l)

pipeline.step: auxiliary_model_initialization: clone theta into hat-theta (Algorithm 1 only)
pipeline.input: theta_1
pipeline.output: hat-theta_1 = theta_1

pipeline.step: penalty relaxation of the bilevel problem into a single-level objective
pipeline.input: upper-level safety losses l(theta; z_i^safe), lower-level weighted losses sigma_i(omega)*l(theta; z_i), penalty constant gamma
pipeline.output: min_{omega,theta} (1-gamma)*(1/M)*sum_i l(theta;z_i^safe) + gamma*p(omega,theta) with p(omega,theta)=(1/N)*(sum_i sigma_i(omega)l(theta;z_i) - min_{theta'} sum_i sigma_i(omega)l(theta';z_i))

pipeline.step: paired sampling of one safe sample and one fine-tuning sample per iteration
pipeline.input: safe dataset D_safe and fine-tuning dataset D
pipeline.output: z_i^safe and z_j (reused by all updates of the iteration)
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 line 3; Algorithm 2 line 3; Appendix A.1

pipeline.step: per-sample length-normalized negative log-likelihood
pipeline.input: sample z=(x,y) with response length d_y; model parameters
pipeline.output: scalar l(theta;z) = -(1/d_y)*sum_{j=1}^{d_y} log P_theta(y_j | x, y_<j)

pipeline.step: penalty-mixed SGD step on the LLM parameters theta
pipeline.input: theta_k; grad of l(theta_k;z_i^safe); grad of sigma_j(omega_k)*l(theta_k;z_j); gamma_k; beta_k
pipeline.output: theta_{k+1}

pipeline.step: SGD step on the auxiliary model hat-theta (Algorithm 1 only)
pipeline.input: hat-theta_k; sigma(omega_k); grad l(hat-theta_k; z_j)
pipeline.output: hat-theta_{k+1} (approximation of theta*(omega_k))

pipeline.step: loss-gap weighted rank update of the selector omega (Algorithm 1)
pipeline.input: l(theta_k;z_j), l(hat-theta_k;z_j), grad sigma_j(omega_k), alpha_k
pipeline.output: omega_{k+1} = omega_k - alpha_k*(l(theta_k;z_j)-l(hat-theta_k;z_j))*grad sigma_j(omega_k)

pipeline.step: memory-efficient rank update without the auxiliary model (Algorithm 2, used in all default experiments)
pipeline.input: l(theta_k;z_j), grad sigma_j(omega_k), alpha_k
pipeline.output: omega_{k+1} = omega_k - alpha_k*l(theta_k;z_j)*grad sigma_j(omega_k)

params.assumption: exists theta* with l(theta*;z_i) ~ 0 for all i, justified by d_theta >> N

pipeline.step: score and rank all N fine-tuning samples with the trained selector
pipeline.input: omega_K; all N samples of D
pipeline.output: sigma_i(omega_K) scores and their descending ranks

pipeline.step: truncate to the top p% to form D_top
pipeline.input: ranks of all N samples; selection percent p
pipeline.output: D_top with p*N samples
pipeline.source: Section 3.3 S3; Section 4.2; Section 4.3; Section 4.5; Table 3

pipeline.step: safe fine-tuning on D_top (S4)
pipeline.input: aligned model theta_1; D_top
pipeline.output: fine-tuned LLM

method: MCD (Model Consistency-Based Defense，基于模型一致性的防御)

pipeline.step: 初始化可信客户端集合 C_tr 与周期编号 f
pipeline.input: 全体客户端集合 C = {c1, ..., cN}
pipeline.output: C_tr = C；f = 0
pipeline.source: Sec. V-B Step 1；Alg. 3 第 1、3 行

pipeline.step: 周期门控，仅当 t % T′ == 0 时执行检测
pipeline.input: 当前 FL 轮次 t；防御周期 T′
pipeline.output: 进入/跳过检测；f = floor(t / T′)
pipeline.source: Alg. 3 第 2–3 行；Sec. V-B Step 1

pipeline.step: 对上传的本地模型做 2 维 PCA 降维
pipeline.input: 客户端 ci 第 t 轮上传的本地模型 θ_t,i ∈ R^d
pipeline.source: Sec. V-A；Sec. V-B Step 1；Alg. 3 第 5 行

pipeline.step: 按客户端缓存本防御周期的低维模型集合 Q_f,i
pipeline.input: 周期内每轮各可信客户端（被选中时）的 2 维模型
pipeline.output: 每个可信客户端的集合 Q_f,i，未选中轮次记 NULL
pipeline.source: Sec. V-B Step 1；Alg. 3 第 5、15 行

pipeline.step: 计算质心度量 θ̄^(2)_f,i
pipeline.input: Q_f,i 中的 θ^(2)_t,i
pipeline.output: 每个客户端的 2 维质心 θ̄^(2)_f,i

pipeline.step: 计算足迹度量 d̄_f,i（到质心的平均欧氏距离）
pipeline.input: Q_f,i 与 θ̄^(2)_f,i
pipeline.output: 每个客户端一个标量 d̄_f,i

pipeline.step: 用第一基线客户端的度量做邻域筛选得到 C_base
pipeline.input: 全部可信客户端的 (θ̄^(2)_f,i, d̄_f,i)；第一基线客户端度量 (θ̂^(2)_f, d̂_f)
pipeline.output: 基线客户端集合 C_base
pipeline.source: 式 (18)(19)；Sec. V-B Step 2；Alg. 2 第 2–5 行；Alg. 3 第 8 行

pipeline.step: 对 C_base 的度量求平均得到两个基线值
pipeline.input: C_base 中所有客户端的 (θ̄^(2)_f,i, d̄_f,i)
pipeline.output: θ^base_f ∈ R^2；d^base_f ∈ R
pipeline.source: 式 (20)(21)；Sec. V-B Step 2；Alg. 2 第 3–4 行

pipeline.step: 计算归一化质心偏差项
pipeline.input: θ̄^(2)_f,i，θ^base_f，d^base_f
pipeline.output: term1 = ‖θ̄^(2)_f,i − θ^base_f‖ / d^base_f
pipeline.source: 式 (22) 第一项；Sec. V-B Step 3

pipeline.step: 计算足迹偏差项
pipeline.input: d̄_f,i 与 d^base_f
pipeline.output: term2 = |d^base_f − d̄_f,i|
pipeline.source: 式 (22) 第二项；Sec. V-B Step 3

pipeline.step: 加权求和得到客户端异常度 h_f,i
pipeline.input: term1、term2
pipeline.output: 每个可信客户端的异常度 h_f,i，汇总为 H_f
pipeline.source: 式 (22)；Sec. V-B Step 3；Alg. 2 第 7–10 行

pipeline.step: 以中位数为基准计算异常阈值
pipeline.input: 全部可信客户端的 h_f,i
pipeline.output: h^med_f；h^thr_f = δ · h^med_f
pipeline.source: 式 (23)；Sec. V-B Step 4；Alg. 3 第 11 行

pipeline.step: 剔除异常度超过阈值的客户端并更新可信集合
pipeline.input: h_f,i、h^thr_f、当前 C_tr
pipeline.output: 更新后的 C_tr；从 Q_f 中删除该客户端的 Q_f,i
pipeline.source: Sec. V-B Step 4；Alg. 3 第 12–17、19 行

pipeline.step: 后续轮次聚合忽略被剔除客户端的更新
pipeline.input: 更新后的 C_tr；每轮被服务器随机选中的 K 个客户端及其模型
pipeline.output: 被标记客户端的后续更新不再被采纳
pipeline.source: Sec. VI-E b) 对 Fig. 15 的说明

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 与步骤 4：按 T′ 轮防御周期运行并按客户端缓存低维模型
quotes.text: MCD runs periodically for every defense period of T ′ FL rounds for local model analysis. In each defense period, MCD stores a set Qf,i of low-dimensional local models uploaded by every trusted client

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：对本地模型做 2 维 PCA 降维
quotes.text: To better analyze the local models, we use PCA to reduce the high-dimensional models to 2-dimensional ones to extract the most useful information.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：未被选中的轮次在 Q_f,i 中置 NULL
quotes.text: In our FL system, the server randomly selects K out of N clients per round for model aggregation, so θ(2) t,i ∈ Qf,i is set to NULL if client ci is not selected in round t.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：足迹度量是到质心的平均欧氏距离
quotes.text: where ¯df,i is the mean of the Euclidean distances, i.e., variances, of all models from the centroid ¯θ(2) f,i

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：第一基线客户端及其 100% 可信假设
quotes.text: Firstly, MCD maintains a first baseline client (for instance, the server acts as a such client to train a local model). This client is considered 100% secure and immune to attacks

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：C_base 的 Ω1、Ω2 邻域约束
quotes.text: Secondly, MCD defines Cbase as the set of baseline clients whose model metrics are within a neighborhood of those of the first baseline client. Two constants Ω1, Ω2 are used to define the size of the neighborhood

quotes.supports: 步骤 11：式 (22) 两项量级不同，用 λ1、λ2 配平
quotes.text: The first half and the second half of Eq. (21) are not of the same order of magnitude. λ1 and λ2 are used to normalize the two parts.

quotes.supports: 步骤 12 与步骤 13：阈值判定与移出可信集合的动作
quotes.text: MCD then marks every client with a client abnormality value larger than the threshold as a malicious client. If MCD detects a malicious client, it will be removed from the trusted client set Ctr.

method: TAR (Tampering Attack Resistance): adversarial meta-training that bakes a tamper-resistant safeguard into open-weight LLM weights by simulating K-step SFT tampering attacks in an inner loop and applying a weighted outer-loop update of a tamper-resistance loss plus a retain/representation-anchor loss

pipeline.step: initial_safeguard
pipeline.input: base LLM weights theta; forget-set input sequences x ~ D_TR; retain data D_retain
pipeline.output: initially safeguarded weights theta_0 = theta_G0

params.objective: min E_x[1 - cosine_similarity(h_theta(x), rand_hashed(x))] + L_LM(theta; D_retain)

pipeline.source: Section 4.1; Algorithm 1 line 1; Appendix C.2 Equation 3

pipeline.step: sample_probe_batch
pipeline.input: D_TR (held-out forget-set split for weaponization; rewritten refusal-preference pairs for refusal)
pipeline.output: x_TR: one held-out minibatch reused across all K inner-loop loss terms in the outer step

pipeline.step: simulate_train_time_attack_trajectory
pipeline.input: theta_{i-1}; one attack config sampled from A_train (dataset, optimizer, LR, schedule, batch size, FT paradigm)
pipeline.output: K = 64 parameter coordinates along the SFT attack trajectory
pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 inner loop; Section 5.1; Appendix E.2 Table 7 and Table 8

pipeline.step: reuse_trajectory_coordinates
pipeline.input: the K parameter coordinates of a single inner-loop SFT trajectory
pipeline.output: K attack samples (K-1 extra non-independent trajectories of increasing length), sampled non-IID from A_train

pipeline.step: subsample_trajectory_coordinates
pipeline.input: K trajectory coordinates
pipeline.output: subset of coordinates used for L_TR (e.g. every 4th adversary optimization step)

pipeline.step: tamper_resistance_loss_weaponization
pipeline.input: attacked parameters attack(theta_{i-1}) at each sampled coordinate; held-out batch x_TR
pipeline.output: scalar L_TR per coordinate (entropy of the attacked model's output distribution, maximized)

params.loss: entropy maximized (implemented as negative entropy minimized)

pipeline.step: tamper_resistance_loss_refusal
pipeline.input: chosen (refusal) vs rejected (harmful) completion pairs from a modified Anthropic-HH-RLHF split; policy model at attack-trajectory coordinates; precomputed reference-model log-probs from base weights theta
pipeline.output: scalar L_TR per coordinate (DPO loss)

params.reference_model: base weights theta, reference log-probs precomputed over the full Anthropic-HH-RLHF dataset

pipeline.step: straight_through_meta_gradient
pipeline.input: L_TR at attacked coordinates; attack written as attack(theta_G) = theta_G + attack'(theta_G)
pipeline.output: approximate gradient grad_{theta_{i-1}} L_TR(attack(theta_{i-1}), x_TR)

params.estimator: straight-through estimator, benefiting from first-order MAML approximations

pipeline.step: accumulate_tamper_resistance_gradient
pipeline.input: per-coordinate L_TR gradients
pipeline.output: g_TR in R^d, accumulated as g_TR += (1/K) * grad L_TR

params.normalization: 1/K per Algorithm 1 line 7; renormalization after coordinate subsampling 论文未说明
params.storage: separate gradient buffer instead of K computation graphs; sharded-gradient only, no extra all-gather/reduce-scatter

pipeline.source: Algorithm 1 inner loop and line 7; Appendix C.5

pipeline.step: retain_gradient
pipeline.input: minibatch x_r ~ D_retain (Pile-bio Retain + Magpie-Align, or Magpie-Align for refusal); residual-stream activations h_{theta_G0}(x_r) of the initially safeguarded model
pipeline.output: g_retain = grad_{theta_{i-1}}( L_LM(theta_{i-1}, x_r) + ||h_{theta_{i-1}}(x_r) - h_{theta_G0}(x_r)||_2^2 ) in R^d

params.relative_weight_of_two_terms: 论文未说明 (Algorithm 1 adds them directly)

pipeline.step: weighted_outer_update
pipeline.input: g_TR, g_retain, learning rate eta, weights lambda_TR and lambda_retain
pipeline.output: theta_i = theta_{i-1} - eta * (lambda_TR * g_TR + lambda_retain * g_retain)
pipeline.source: Section 4.2 Equation 1; Algorithm 1 line 12; Section 5.1; Section 5.2

pipeline.step: optional_benign_sft_refusal_only
pipeline.input: theta_G after the outer loop; Magpie-Align data
pipeline.output: final TAR refusal model reported in Table 2

sampling.how: outer tamper-resistance steps N, each simulating K-step SFT attacks
inner-loop SFT trajectory length K per outer step, compared over {8,16,32,64}
trajectory coordinate reuse (one rollout yields K non-independent attack samples) and coordinate sub-sampling along the trajectory
sampling.size: K = 64; sub-sample every 4 adversary optimization steps (Appendix C.4)

sampling.how: one held-out minibatch x_TR sampled per outer step from the held-out split of D_TR and reused for every inner-loop L_TR term
sampling.size: 1 minibatch per outer step; batch size 论文未说明 (Appendix C.4, Appendix E.2)

sampling.how: 80-20 split of each forget set into adversary data (for A_train attacks) and held-out data (for computing tamper-resistance losses)
reference/probe dataset sizes for the weaponization setting

论文未使用抽样; Random Mapping is defined on the residual stream at every layer
