forget/safety proxy data: Pile-bio Forget (7,558), Camel-bio Forget (54,258), OOD Forget (598,933), private chemical-security forget set, CTFtime cybersecurity writeups (>18k) (Appendix E.1)
retain/capability proxy data: Pile-bio Retain (42,426) mixed with Magpie-Align instruction-tuning data (Appendix E.1, E.2)

refusal setting: Anthropic-HH-RLHF rejected completions for train-time attacks, plus a modified split whose rejected completions are replaced with refusals for the DPO loss; base weights theta used as DPO reference model with precomputed reference log-probs (Appendix E.2)
initial safeguarded model theta_G0 whose residual-stream activations serve as the Equation 2 anchor (Section 4.2)
train-time adversary set A_train: 6 adversaries per weaponization domain, 3 for refusal (Table 7, Table 8)
compute: 8 x NVIDIA 80GB A100, FSDP, DeepSpeed ZeRO Stage 3 (Appendix C.5)

evaluation resources: WMDP (3,668 questions), MMLU (57 tasks), HarmBench, MT-Bench, Toxic-DPO v0.2 (541 harmful chats), 26/24 weaponization test adversaries (Table 9), 5 refusal test adversaries (Table 10)
dominant_cost: N outer steps, each requiring a K = 64-step simulated SFT attack rollout (forward+backward per step) plus one L_TR forward/backward per sub-sampled trajectory coordinate (about every 4th step) and one retain-term forward/backward; the paper calls simulating K attacks per outer update 'prohibitively expensive' (Appendix C.4) and notes K computation graphs are infeasible in memory (Appendix C.5), but reports no wall-clock, GPU-hour or memory numbers (论文未说明). 分析：cost scales roughly with N x K x model size x sequence length.
underspecified: outer-loop batch size for D_TR and D_retain is never given (only the inner adversary batch size 64)
relative weighting of the two terms inside Equation 2 (L_LM vs the l2 activation anchor) is not given; Algorithm 1 line 10 simply adds them

the anchor reference is written h_theta in Algorithm 1 but h_{theta_G0} in Equation 2 and Section 4.2; whether it is the base model or the initially safeguarded model must be decided by the implementer
the exact definition of the entropy loss is unspecified: which token positions, which distribution, and how it is reduced over the sequence
gradient normalization after coordinate sub-sampling is unspecified (Algorithm 1 shows 1/K, but only a subset of coordinates receives L_TR); the stride 4 is only given as an example
Random Mapping (Appendix C.2) gives no optimizer, learning rate, step count or batch size, and no dimensionality/alignment details for rand_hashed vectors
the semantics of the beta(6.0, 3.0) R->F switching point (fraction of the 64 steps vs absolute step count) is unspecified
how Algorithm 1's 'for k = 1 to K' loop relates to the trajectory-coordinate reuse of Appendix C.4 (whether K forwards are still run) is unspecified
for refusal: the DPO beta, the exact construction of chosen/rejected pairs (the [6] rewriting procedure), and any length normalization are unspecified
the specific initial refusal safeguard (RLHF vs DPO, and its data) used to produce the TAR refusal model is unspecified
hyperparameters of the extra 100 benign SFT steps (learning rate, batch size) are unspecified
whether the absolute-value bars in the extracted Equation 3 reflect the paper's intent, given that the prose says the objective maximizes cosine similarity

quotes.supports: 步骤 1 初始安全防护（武器化设置用 Random Mapping）
quotes.text: As a proxy for scrubbing target representations according to downstream task labels, we propose a weaponization knowledge restriction safeguard termed Random Mapping, which maps hθ(DTR) to random noise as follows:

quotes.supports: 步骤 2 与步骤 8：每个外层步用同一个 held-out 批次算 L_TR 以降低方差
quotes.text: Additionally, we reduce variance in the tamper-resistance gradient by computing the tamper-resistance loss at each inner loop step on the same held-out batch, denoted as xTR in Algorithm 1.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3 与步骤 7：把攻击写成扰动并用直线估计器反传
quotes.text: defining attack(θG) = θ′G = θG + attack′(θG) as a perturbation on top of initial parameters, where backpropagation through attack′ is approximated with a straight-through estimator [5].

quotes.supports: 步骤 4 轨迹坐标复用（一次 rollout 得到 K 个攻击样本）
quotes.text: we leverage an efficiency trick: we can reuse the coordinates along steps of a single adversary fine-tuning trajectory of length K to obtain K −1 additional (though non-independent) trajectories of increasing length.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5 沿轨迹子采样坐标
quotes.text: To further improve runtime efficiency, we do not compute the tamper-resistance loss LTR on all K steps and instead sub-sample coordinates along the trajectory for computing LTR within an adversary batch, for example every 4 adversary optimization steps.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6a 武器化设置把 L_TR 取为被最大化的熵
quotes.text: We choose the tamper-resistance loss LTR as an entropy loss to be maximized during the adversary's cross-entropy fine-tuning trajectory, since maximizing entropy would impede the adversary's cross entropy loss from decreasing during fine-tuning.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6b 拒绝设置把 L_TR 取为沿攻击轨迹的 DPO 损失
quotes.text: the sampled attack performs SFT on rejected completions, and the tamper-resistance loss LTR is a DPO loss computed on the pair chosen and rejected completions on parameter coordinates along the attack trajectory.

quotes.supports: 步骤 9 retain 项把表示锚回初始防护模型
quotes.text: Empirically, we find that pushing retain-set residual stream representations to be close to the base model θG0 via the ℓ2-norm loss in Equation 2 maintains a high capabilities_metric(θG).

method: 谱特征（spectral signatures）：先在可能被污染的完整训练集上训练网络 L，按标签分组提取每个样本的学习表征，做类内中心化后取该类表征矩阵的最大右奇异向量 v，以样本在 v 上投影的平方为离群分，删除每类分数最高的 1.5ε 比例样本，再从随机初始化重训；论文为集中式方法，未涉及联邦流程。

pipeline.step: 按标签分组训练样本
pipeline.input: 带标签训练集 Dtrain = {(x_i, y_i)}，图像 x_i（CIFAR-10 为 3×32×32）
pipeline.output: C 个按标签划分的子集 D_y，以及每类的样本枚举 x_1..x_n（n=|D_y|）

pipeline.step: 在完整（可能被污染的）训练集上训练模型 L
pipeline.input: Dtrain
pipeline.output: 训练好的网络 L 及其内部表征函数 R(·)

params.architecture: ResNet：3 组 residual layer，filter 数 [16,16,32,64]，每组 5 个 residual unit（§4.1）

pipeline.step: 为每个类提取逐样本表征
pipeline.input: D_y 中的每个样本 x_i 与模型 L
pipeline.output: n×d 的逐样本表征矩阵（d 为表征维数，论文未给出具体数值）

params.layer: 倒数第二个 residual unit（§4.1）；VGG 结果见 Table 5

pipeline.step: 类内中心化
pipeline.input: n×d 表征矩阵
pipeline.output: 类内均值 R̂（d 维）与中心化矩阵 M = [R(x_i) − R̂]（n×d）

params.mean: R̂ = (1/n) Σ_{i=1..n} R(x_i)（Algorithm 1 第 6 行）

pipeline.step: 取最大右奇异向量

quotes.supports: 步骤 1–3：先训练网络，再按类提取逐样本表征
quotes.text: We ﬁrst train a neural network on the data. Then, for each class, we extract a learned representation for each input from that class.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：表征来自网络中指定的学习表征层
quotes.text: We take a black-box neural network with some designated learned representation. This can typically be the representation from an autoencoder or a layer in a deep network that is believed to represent high level features.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4–6：在表征协方差上做 SVD 并计算逐样本离群分
quotes.text: We next take the singular value decomposition of the covariance matix of these representations and use this to compute an outlier score for each example.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5–7：用 SVD 检测并删除提供信号的样本
quotes.text: As long as the signal is large in magnitude, we can detect it via singular value decomposition and remove the images that provide the signal.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7–8：只做一次剔除并重训
quotes.text: We then record the number of poisoned images left after one removal step and the accuracies upon retraining.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：表征层选择为倒数第二个 residual unit
quotes.text: We choose to report the results for the second to last residual unit simply because, on average, the method applied to this layer removed the most poisoned images.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：必须在学习表征上检测，输入层面信号不足

quotes.text: We compute an LLM’s standard loss for a pair of prompt and response ‘Sure’; and then calculate the gradient of the loss with respect to the LLM’s parameters.

quotes.supports: 步骤 3：梯度矩阵按行、列切片及 Llama-2 7b 的切片总数
quotes.text: for each gradient matrix, we slice them both row-wise and column-wise, leading to a total 2, 498, 560 slices (1, 138, 688 columns and 1, 359, 872 rows) for Llama-2 7b.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：Phase I 用不安全提示的切片平均作为参考
quotes.text: In Phase I, we obtain the average of the gradient slices for all unsafe prompts, which serve as reference gradient slices for subsequent cosine similarity computations.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6：Phase III 用不安全平均余弦减安全平均余弦得到 gap
quotes.text: In Phase III, our aim is to identify parameter slices with the largest gradient similarity gaps between unsafe and safe prompts. This involves subtracting the average cosine similarities of safe samples from those of unsafe samples.

quotes.supports: 步骤 6 输出：超过阈值的切片成为安全关键参数，其参考切片存为不安全梯度参考
quotes.text: These marked parameter slices are recognized as safety-critical parameters (e.g., the third slice in Figure 3), and the corresponding gradient slices from the reference gradient slices are stored as unsafe gradient references.

quotes.supports: 步骤 9a：GradSafe-Zero 跨安全关键切片平均打分并阈值判定
quotes.text: The resulting cosine similarities are averaged across all slices of safety-critical parameters, yielding a score. A prompt with score exceeding a predetermined threshold is identified as unsafe.

quotes.supports: 步骤 9b：GradSafe-Adapt 以余弦相似度为特征训练逻辑回归检测器

quotes.supports: 步骤 A1：服务器把当前模型广播给所有 worker
quotes.text: In each parallel iteration of the algorithms, the master machine broadcasts the current model parameter to all worker machines.

quotes.supports: 步骤 A2：正常 worker 计算本地梯度并回传
quotes.text: The normal worker machines compute the gradients of their local loss functions and then send the gradients back to the master machine.

quotes.supports: 步骤 A4 与 A5：用中位数（或截尾均值）聚合后做一步步长为 η 的梯度更新
quotes.text: The master machine then performs a gradient descent update on the model parameter with step-size η, using either the coordinate-wise median or trimmed mean of the received gradients.

quotes.supports: 步骤 A4：逐坐标中位数的精确定义
quotes.text: For vectors xi ∈Rd, i ∈[m], the coordinate-wise median g := med{xi : i ∈[m]} is a vector with its k-th coordinate being gk = med{xi k : i ∈[m]} for each k ∈[d]

quotes.supports: 步骤 A5：投影保证参数留在参数空间内
quotes.text: The Euclidean projection ΠW(·) ensures that the model parameter stays in the parameter space W.

quotes.supports: 步骤 A3：拜占庭可发任意消息且可合谋，因此方法不做识别而只做鲁棒聚合
quotes.text: The Byzantine machines need not obey this protocol and can send arbitrary messages to the master; in particular, they may have complete knowledge of the system and learning algorithms, and can collude with each other.

quotes.supports: 步骤 B2：一次性算法对本地 ERM 逐坐标取中位数
quotes.text: As detailed in Algorithm 2, we employ the coordinate-wise median operation to aggregate all the ERMs.

quotes.supports: 第 4 节与第 6 节的规模条件：中位数法要多出一个 1/n 项，n ≳ m 时才阶最优
quotes.text: When each worker machine has a sufficient amount of data, more specifically n ≳m, we achieve an order-optimal error rate up to logarithmic factors.

pipeline.step: 检测启动门控
pipeline.input: 当前轮次 t（标量）

pipeline.source: §5.1（默认第 50 轮开始检测）；§5.2 Fig 4(b) 扫描 10–60

pipeline.step: 接收并缓存客户端更新
pipeline.input: 本轮 n 个客户端上传的模型更新 g_i^t，展平为 n×p；以及上一轮缓存的 g_i^{t−1}（n×p）
pipeline.output: 更新矩阵 G^t（n×p）与 G^{t−1}（n×p）
pipeline.source: §3 与公式 (1)；公式 (3) 隐含需要 g_i^{t−1}

pipeline.step: 聚合得到全局更新
pipeline.input: n×p 的客户端更新矩阵
pipeline.output: 全局更新 g^t（p 维）

params.rule: FedAvg|Krum|Trimmed-Mean|Median

pipeline.step: 计算全局模型差与全局更新差
pipeline.output: Δw^t = w^t − w^{t−1}（p 维）、Δg^t = g^t − g^{t−1}（p 维）

pipeline.step: 维护长度 N 的滑动窗口缓冲
pipeline.input: 每轮的 Δw、Δg 流
pipeline.output: ΔW^t（p×N）、ΔG^t（p×N），窗口为过去 N 轮不含当前轮

pipeline.step: L-BFGS 估计 Hessian 向量积
pipeline.input: ΔW^t（p×N）、ΔG^t（p×N）、v = w^t − w^{t−1}（p 维）、窗口 N
pipeline.output: Ĥ^t v（p 维），即 Ĥ^t(w^t − w^{t−1})

pipeline.step: 预测每个客户端的更新
pipeline.input: 上一轮实收更新 g_i^{t−1}（n×p）与 HVP 向量 Ĥ^t(w^t − w^{t−1})（p 维）
pipeline.output: 预测更新 ĝ_i^t = g_i^{t−1} + Ĥ^t(w^t − w^{t−1})（n×p）

pipeline.step: 计算预测-实收更新的欧氏距离向量
pipeline.input: 预测更新 ĝ_i^t 与实收更新 g_i^t（各 n×p）
pipeline.output: d^t = [‖ĝ_i^t − g_i^t‖₂]（n 维）

pipeline.step: L1 归一化距离向量
pipeline.input: d^t（n 维）
pipeline.output: d̂^t = d^t / ‖d^t‖₁（n 维，和为 1）

pipeline.step: 窗口平均得到可疑分
pipeline.input: 过去 N 轮的 d̂

pipeline.step: Gap statistics 确定簇数
pipeline.input: s^t（n 维可疑分）、B、K、n
pipeline.output: 簇数 k̂

pipeline.step: k-means 二聚类
pipeline.input: s^t（n 维），仅当 k̂ > 1 时执行
pipeline.output: 两个簇的成员划分

pipeline.step: 选出恶意簇
pipeline.input: 两个簇的成员及其可疑分
pipeline.output: 恶意客户端集合（可能为空）

pipeline.step: 剔除并重启训练
pipeline.input: 恶意客户端集合
pipeline.output: 剩余客户端集合与重训后的全局模型

quotes.supports: 整体检测思路：良性客户端遵循 FL 算法、恶意客户端伪造更新，因而更新序列不一致
quotes.text: Our key intuition is that, benign clients calculate their model updates based on the FL algorithm and their local training data, while malicious clients craft the model updates instead of following the FL algorithm.

quotes.supports: 步骤 4：Δw^t 与 Δg^t 的定义，且 g^t 由客户端更新聚合而来
quotes.text: Specifically, we denote by Δ𝑤𝑡= 𝑤𝑡−𝑤𝑡−1 the global-model difference in iteration 𝑡, and we denote by Δ𝑔𝑡= 𝑔𝑡−𝑔𝑡−1 the global-model-update difference in iteration 𝑡, where the global model update is aggregated from the clients’ model updates.

quotes.supports: 步骤 5–6：用过去 N 轮的 ΔW^t、ΔG^t 经 L-BFGS 估计 Ĥ^t，具体实现见 Algorithm 1
quotes.text: Then, based on the L-BFGS algorithm, we can estimate Hˆ 𝑡using Δ𝑊𝑡and Δ𝐺𝑡. For simplicity, we denote by Hˆ 𝑡= L-BFGS(Δ𝑊𝑡, Δ𝐺𝑡). Algorithm 1 shows the specific implementation of L-BFGS algorithm in the experiments.

quotes.supports: 步骤 7：客户端更新预测公式 (3)
quotes.text: Based on the estimated Hessian Hˆ 𝑡, we predict a client 𝑖’s model update in iteration 𝑡as follows: 𝑔ˆ𝑡 𝑖= 𝑔𝑡−1 𝑖 + Hˆ 𝑡(𝑤𝑡−𝑤𝑡−1), (3) where 𝑔ˆ𝑡 𝑖is the predicted model update for client 𝑖in iteration 𝑡.

quotes.supports: 步骤 8–9：逐客户端 ℓ2 欧氏距离向量 d^t 与 ℓ1 归一化 d̂^t
quotes.text: We denote by 𝑑𝑡the vector of such 𝑛Euclidean distances for the𝑛clients in iteration𝑡, i.e.,𝑑𝑡= [∥𝑔ˆ𝑡 1−𝑔𝑡 1∥2, ∥𝑔ˆ𝑡 2−𝑔𝑡 2∥2, · · · , ∥𝑔ˆ𝑡𝑛− 𝑔𝑡𝑛∥2]. We normalize the vector 𝑑𝑡as 𝑑ˆ𝑡= 𝑑𝑡/∥𝑑𝑡∥1.

quotes.supports: 步骤 10：可疑分定义为最近 N 轮归一化距离的平均，N 为窗口大小
quotes.text: Finally, our suspicious score 𝑠𝑡 𝑖for client 𝑖in iteration 𝑡is the client’s average normalized Euclidean distance in the past 𝑁iterations, i.e., 𝑠𝑡 𝑖= 1 𝑁 ∑︁𝑁−1 𝑟=0 𝑑ˆ𝑡−𝑟 𝑖 . We call 𝑁 window size.

quotes.supports: 步骤 11–13：Gap statistics 判断簇数，k̂>1 时 k-means(k=2)，平均可疑分大的簇判为恶意
quotes.text: If the clients can be grouped into more than 1 cluster based on the Gap statistics, then we use 𝑘-means to divide the clients into 2 clusters based on their suspicious scores. Finally, the clients in the cluster with larger average suspicious score are classified as malicious.

quotes.supports: 步骤 14：判定触发即停止训练、剔除客户端并重启
quotes.text: When at least one client is classified as malicious in a certain iteration, the detection finishes, and the server removes the clients classified as malicious and restarts the training.
